## Remember Lisa Hanson?
### Tuesday, June 14th, 2022
Friend, The tyrannical rule of Tim Walz with his mandates and lockdowns are being forgotten today by those who didn't have to sacrifice much. But the impacts they had on some Minnesotans was devastating. Walz destroyed small businesses, which were built on the backs of good people, working hard and chasing the American dream. A dozen brave business owners stood up to Walz' illegal orders and in the case of Lisa Hanson, that [put her behind bars](https://www.action4liberty.com/judge_sentences_lisa_hanson?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=remember_lisa&n=2). Few can say they fought as hard as Lisa did to preserve liberty. Now there is a documentary about Lisa's fight which I would recommend you watch. [](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=w5XKTZ0h8dEcNEoc_HghfL_baLHklwByIJomM0FyGDhoE8zBqsZXGO1gFAoxzCl3QOu-LRuU6txMi1m2wulD0_nZ5okKPW-FUgvR4TtJPrNNW6ai5pLqCDPUj2YkXU1i&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=remember_lisa&n=3)[](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRb2XAXkYEf2yI4563T2JYa9wi_PwhFcXD1KpoL1g5W0Dw&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=remember_lisa&n=4) Lisa is now [running for the Minnesota Senate](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=YRKcG7pNk8LPrdqQE5mF0To1v4AVQSjFeLGBUiG0xPArO9wn-wmZqGKqoMA5UN_2&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=remember_lisa&n=5). It's always encouraging to see outsiders run for office. The current crop of politicians have little interest in passing the Never Again Bill or giving back ALL of the surplus. The status quo is failing us tremendously. **Speaking of politicians, if you haven't seen our latest video on who the culprit behind rising gas prices is, please[WATCH HERE](https://www.action4liberty.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRYbYIQmOAnvHyqHAwAyTvATtcuO-mmrdLxk5uLwHgZkyA&e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=remember_lisa&n=6). ** Also, stay tuned this Thursday as we reveal some exciting news you won't want to miss.

Early voting starts in less than three weeks! Please help Harriet by making sure your friends and family get out to vote! Contact Kael at [kael@hagemanforwyoming.com](mailto:kael@hagemanforwyoming.com "kael@hagemanforwyoming.com") if you are interested in volunteering. There are numerous candidate forums and meet-and-greets scheduled for the coming weeks throughout the state. We are doing our best to get to as many as possible, but conflicts do arise. If you have an event in your area that Harriet should attend, or one that you would volunteer to be there on behalf of the campaign and distribute literature, please let Carly know at [carly@hagemanforwyoming.com](mailto:carly@hagemanforwyoming.com "carly@hagemanforwyoming.com") For Wyoming, Team Hageman --- **Around Wyoming! ** Harriet and Congressman Jim Banks visited Cheyenne and Laramie to meet with local veterans and discuss ways to improve services and to address the challenges faced by our veteran population. In Casper, Harriet attended the pro-life prayer vigil, and then gave a presentation about Biden’s 30x30 land grab to the Campaign for Liberty. Harriet also spoke at Girls State in Cheyenne. It was a busy week with additional events in Glendo, Douglas, Casper, and horse races in Gillette! --- --- --- --- --- --- Voter Contact! County leads across the state have been active -- from Casper to Laramie to Sheridan to Jackson! Door-to-door voter contact will be one of the most important aspects of our campaign between now and August 16th. If you are interested in helping, please contact Kael at [kael@hagemanforwyoming.com](mailto:kael@hagemanforwyoming.com "kael@hagemanforwyoming.com") for training so that you can reach voters in your city and area. It is vitally important that we have direct contact with as many voters as possible to ensure they will show up at the polls. Colorado Public Schools in Decline

http://www.lopez2022.com?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=bdf1f1a974-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_15_02_43&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-bdf1f1a974-584862049

** We need action to rebuild our education system, we need
------------------------------------------------------------

** One of Us for All of Us.
------------------------------------------------------------

New Data Shows Student Enrollment Trending Down Across Denver, Elementary Schools Especially Impacted (https://denver.cbslocal.com/2022/06/07/data-shows-student-enrollment-trending-down-denver-elementary-schools-impacted/?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=bdf1f1a974-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_15_02_43&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-bdf1f1a974-584862049)

Denver Public Schools (DPS) presented the annual student enrollment trends report this week which showed “overall enrollment is trending down, the hardest hit were elementary schools as well as overall enrollment in schools in southwest Denver.”
DPS reports that rising housing prices and declining birthrates are the main causes for declining enrollment, two issues affecting the Latino population the most.
“The district is likely to face some challenges in the road ahead on understanding how many schools it can continue to support as a result of losing several thousand students, particularly when it’s happening to elementary schools and when it’s happening on the west side of the city,” said Eschbacher.

** Extended School Shutdowns and Mask Mandates caused a Mass Exodus from Colorado Public Schools
------------------------------------------------------------

Denver is not the only district facing budget shortfalls created by declining enrollment, resulting in personnel cuts and school consolidations.
Jefferson County Public Schools (JeffCo) reports 57 schools are at 65% capacity, when 80% capacity is the standard for remaining open. 49 elementary schools are at risk of closure. JeffCo is $165M over budget with 40,000 empty seats.

The top withdrawal reasons for 2020-21 were transfers to other districts (795 students) and transfers out of state (677 students). JeffCo had the longest school mask mandate in the state, contributing to parents demanding the resignation of JCPH Director Dawn Comstock. (https://denver.cbslocal.com/2022/02/08/dawn-comstock-jefferson-health-director/?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=bdf1f1a974-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_15_02_43&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-bdf1f1a974-584862049)

(https://www.foxnews.com/politics/white-house-teachers-unions-labor-disputes-school-reopening-guidance-emails?utm_source=Greg+Lopez+For+Governor&utm_campaign=bdf1f1a974-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2022_06_15_02_43&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_9fbc254cd8-bdf1f1a974-584862049)

People over Politics

As your Governor, I will NEVER order extended school shutdowns and I will ALWAYS let parents make health decisions. I will support school choice and homeschool parents. Parents will always maintain the right to find the best educational options when politics interfere with sound policy.

Greg Lopez

name: Ron Johnson
subject: Peter , can I count on you to join me?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
|
---
| | | Peter,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask, Peter, for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.
---
| | | [ENDORSE RON JOHNSON](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60587147:JCAAPeoNe:m:1:3253819041:7535B82D6E3549FC7C8DE71B96E3AC1C:r "ENDORSE RON JOHNSON")
---
Thank you,
Ron Johnson

name: Ron Johnson
subject: Your endorsement matters to me.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion.
|
---
| | | Peter,

I decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 2010 because growing entitlements and out-of-control federal spending had exploded our national debt to $14 trillion. We were on an unsustainable path that was mortgaging our children's future.

Fortunately, Americans decided that a government controlled by liberal Democrats wasn't good for the country, and they elected Republicans to the House to halt President Obama's extreme policies. A Republican majority in the Senate followed in 2014.

As I ran for re-election in 2016, we had the prospect of electing a Republican president who could work with a Republican Congress not only to stop the expansion of liberal policies but, we hoped, to reverse some of the damage done during Mr. Obama's administration. I figured we had an opportunity to put America back on the right path, and I was more than willing to dedicate myself to that worthy effort.

By and large, Republican policies worked. Regulatory relief and a more competitive tax system helped create a healthy economy with low inflation and record low unemployment. Strengthening the military deterred our enemies, and policies designed to secure the borders dramatically reduced the flow of illegal immigration.

During the 2016 campaign, I said it would be my last campaign and final term. That was my strong preference, and my wife's--we both looked forward to a normal private life. However, neither of us anticipated the Democrats' complete takeover of government and the disastrous policies they have already inflicted on America and the world, to say nothing of those they threaten to enact in the future.

Nor did we anticipate the pandemic, the government's failed response to it, the loss of freedom that has resulted, and the tyrannical approach taken by the elites who have created and maintained a state of fear that allows them to exercise control over Americans' lives. Instead of everyone working to achieve the goal President Biden stated during his inaugural address--unifying and healing America--it feels as if our nation is being torn apart.

As I travel around Wisconsin and talk to citizens who love our country, I know I am not the only one with grave concerns. My message has always been that America is precious, and it is our solemn duty to make sure it survives and thrives for future generations.

President Reagan warned that freedom is fragile, always one generation away from extinction. As I have told crowds since my first Tea Party speeches in 2010: This is a fight for freedom. This is not someone else's fight, this is our fight, and it's a fight we absolutely must win.

I believe America is in peril. Much as I'd like to ease into a quiet retirement, I don't feel I should. Countless people have encouraged me to run, saying they rely on me to be their voice, to speak plain and obvious truths other elected leaders shirk from expressing--truths the elite in government, mainstream media, and Big Tech don't want you to hear.

In 2010 I promised I would always tell people the truth and that I would never vote with re-election in mind. When re-election isn't your primary motivation, those are easy promises to keep. Today, I am announcing I will continue to fight for freedom in the public realm by running for re-election. It is a decision I haven't made lightly. Having already experienced a growing level of vitriol and false attacks, I certainly don't expect better treatment in the future. For my campaign to succeed, I will need the support of every American who values the truth and refuses to allow lies and distortions to prevail.

Tens of millions of dollars will be spent trying to destroy and defeat me. The mainstream media and Big Tech will contribute their powerful and corrupt voices as the unofficial but reliable communication apparatus of the Democrats. We face powerful forces that desire even more power and control over our lives. Their path, paved with false hope and greater dependency, always leads to tyranny. We cannot let them win.

So I will humbly ask, Peter, for your endorsement to help me SAVE AMERICA.
---
| | | [ENDORSE RON JOHNSON](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60587243:6XmPPeoaN:m:1:3317145305:8768182419DE0B6A0151878F5F3DEC37:r "ENDORSE RON JOHNSON")
---
Thank you,
Ron Johnson
---

I have just announced my campaign for re-election to the U.S. Senate.

This will not be an easy win but I am ready to fight to **SAVE AMERICA** from the Democrats.

name: Great America Update
subject: Survey on an urgent matter
body:
A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c612934%7c6043%7c6%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c1&wdmdk=wiQYsPT%2bkv%2bS%2bsNoVWSxCg&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from Great America Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63562%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=lsjouMYjJwsdi3rlIG9q3A&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63563%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=j%2fj%2fSczjbPiqfNVyx3XwZw&sysid=1)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c63563%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=j%2fj%2fSczjbPiqfNVyx3XwZw&sysid=1)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Jackson Lahmeyer
subject: Why Jackson Lahmeyer Over James Lankford For US Senate In Oklahoma?
body:
Lahmeyer vs Lankford In Oklahoma, there are two candidates running for the Full-Term US Senate seat: outsider Jackson Lahmeyer & DC-insider James La
| | |
---
## Lahmeyer vs Lankford
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6697.1.fc1331ecd36b82849cb2cdf0373a7728)
---
In Oklahoma, there are **two candidates** running for the _Full-Term_ US Senate seat: outsider [Jackson Lahmeyer](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6698.1.38bc54f87e8aff780eaa459437b182fb) & DC-insider [James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6699.1.eea0d151f7b43f600ecb9622a021d8b8).
[Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6700.1.dce16c1fb0e67eda4dea591151f1188b) is a household name among Republican voters in Oklahoma but cannot break 50% in the polls even though he has spent over $3,000,000.00.
The reason that [Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6701.1.c3c183cf6dad1e59c4ce657f0bc1874a) is doing so poorly in the most Conservative state in the Union, is because he is **America Last** and **anti-Trump**.
[Lahmeyer](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6702.1.530449adad21ae118dde31673347b449) is a proud Trump supporter who is supported by many of President Trump's closest allies such as **General Michael Flynn** , **Roger Stone** , **Mayor Rudy Giuliani** and **Mike Lindell**. [Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6703.1.faba690a020e0b3d23a0837ea8bb5c16) is one of two incumbent US Senators **NOT** endorsed by President Trump.
Why should Oklahoma choose [Lahmeyer](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6704.1.4405851f3a6a54dfd799e037535367f3) over [Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6705.1.75174b8058bbd580ac7a524342ff07fc)?
The message below from [Jackson Lahmeyer](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6706.1.913c30c35d5768ac3c22718fc9a96ed9) makes the case.
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6707.1.98f9cbbc909ea4834f5974ff783c7cbe)
---
## Message From Jackson Lahmeyer
---
In Oklahoma, people are seeing **"Lahmeyer For Senate"** signs, billboards, ads and etc... scattered throughout all 77 counties. All of these signs cause _curiosity_ : **"Who Is Jackson Lahmeyer?"** If you read the _Washington Post_ you will get the impression that I'm a threat to democracy; if you read the _[Oklahoma City Sentine](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6708.1.6ad0fc162d9ed717cd6e90daf6f90ed4)l_ you will get the impression that I'm a Patriot endorsed by National Leaders such as **General Michael Flynn** , **Roger Stone** , Mayor Rudy Giuliani, **Mike Lindell** and others including organizations such as the Oklahoma Second Amendemnet Association, Oklahomans For Health & Parental Rights and the Oil & Gas Workers Association. I figured that I should write to you and let you know who I really am and what my background is. I'm **definitely not** a _Career Politician_ or a _Washinton Insider_. I'm a 4th generation Oklahoman from the Claremore area. I started my first of many businesses at the age of 15. That first business I started was a simple Lawn Care that still operates today. I attended **Oral Roberts University** (ORU) and received a B.A. & M.A. in Theological & Historical Studies graduating Magna Cum Laude. While at ORU, I served as a Youth Pastor at a few different local churches that gave me the opportunity to get my start in ministry. Upon graduation from ORU, I stepped in as the Crusade Director for **Christ for All Nations** , the ministry of **Reinhard Bonnke** that has helped lead 74,000,000 people to Christ since 1974. While serving as the Crusade Director, I also became the Oklahoma State Coordinator for the **Billy Graham Evangelistic Association** (a position I held for 5 years). In 2017, my wife, Kendra, and I were honored to become the Lead Pastors of the historic **Sheridan Christian Center** in Tulsa, OK – now known as [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6709.1.601c2748335e9b716c8de8a7667385d2). [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6710.1.e9669adbb66b41497fbfbe812e8e0d49)was founded in 1951 and has been one of the most influential churches in the state of Oklahoma with 30 other churches and ministries being planted out of it. Some of those churches and ministries include: **Victory.Church** in Tulsa, **Rhema Bible Training Center** in Broken Arrow, **Eastland Assembly of God** in Tulsa, **Trinity Bible College** and so many more. While pastoring [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6711.1.4653545fbc94cdc2455213724d1c1fed), I've also been an Instructor of Theology at **Victory College** from 2017 to 2021 and in 2019, I served as the interim Dean of Theology at **Victory College** while they transitioned in leadership. The Lord has been very good to me professionally with the opportunities He has given me but the Lord has been even better to me with the family He has given me. My wife, Kendra, and I are very grateful for the _basketball team_ of 5 kids we get to raise and train up.
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6712.1.7046d2c6bd622312847ec5111ce086c9)
---
We currently live in Owasso, OK right outside Tulsa.
It was a little more than a year ago that **Kendra** and **General Michael Flynn** nudged me to run for the US Senate in Oklahoma to challenge and replace [James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6713.1.35fd3918fb1b67a534b807b9322245a4).
I get asked quite often, "_Why are you running_?"
**I am running to finish President Trump's border wall.**
[James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6714.1.820758747a3953b88e7fac47d63a05a3) mocked President Trump's border wall.
**I am running against Joe Biden's socialist agenda.**
[James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6715.1.b81accdcb4e0bfee2ce6aefdecef1ffd) votes with the Biden Administration over 51% of the time.
**I am running to defend the Second Amendment.**
[James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6716.1.e85fd3c3f38dc64443e3b03a8e5680b1) has an "F rating" from Gun Owners of America.
**I am running against the radical Left's cancel culture.**
[James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6717.1.76026611edacb4a57d95acc6e6f7bbe6) caved to the radical Left and proposed renaming our military bases.
**I am running to investigate the 2020 election.**
[James Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6718.1.c1263662291722ac67a67b597bde8f61) voted to certify the 2020 election.
**I am running to put AMERICA FIRST!**
When I arrive in DC on **Day 1** , I will have 3 goals:
1\. Sponsor legislation in the Senate to cutoff ALL federal funding to any school district in America that teaches **Critical Race Theory** or **Woke Sexuality**. I have labeled the legation the Millstone Act (see Luke 17:2).
2\. Sponsor legislation in the Senate that BANS Chinese Nationalists or any other foreign entity from purchasing **American farmland**.
3\. Join forces with Rand Paul in the Senate to bring justice to **Anothony Fauci**.
A recent poll was released from Just Oklahoma Data that surveyed 503 _likely_ Oklahoma Republican primary voters: [Lankford](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6719.1.8fa76c381c89054ec49a473802e9fb8c) received 46.3%, [Lahmeyer](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6720.1.37efe987df9dcf813d53141d1908a1b2) 41.4% and 11.2% were undecided. We have gained so much ground in such a short amount of time.
Our campaign has turned into a movement across Oklahoma with Rallies that are attended by thousands as well having raised nearly $1,000,000.00 from 10k donors.
I believe in this final stretch leading up to Election Day on June 28th we will close the gap.
I NEED YOUR HELP to finish the job. 12% of the Republican electorate is undecided because they do not know who I am... _yet_.
This is where you can help spread word by texting friends and family members the picture comparing [Lankford's](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6721.1.5faef3acaced1b8395aaeba18605d870) stances vs [Lahmeyer's](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6722.1.12da74b620e7ab0c2c002e8de084d8ed)stances as well as posting on social media.
**The Best Is Yet To Come!**
I would appreciate your support on June 28.
Learn more at [www.jacksonlahmeyer.com](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6723.1.76eaa132d1f6885de282c43b30d4e46e)
Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer
Follow me on [TruthSocial](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6724.1.434515d7d92b824e20e2ab681c870d10), GAB, [Facebook](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6725.1.3120d1e34c50d20fe47f44738d993d84), [Instagram](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6726.1.69e404e7f50b771dc92d40dad17edda3), [Twitter](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6727.1.f98040326ebc4359d1dbcdf3ea499fb0), [Telegram](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6728.1.b109613b21e038046c9ea87847ee1bec), GETTR & [YouTube](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6729.1.2c3167dff3e2d2b18f126bb115152656)).
| | [ Watch Jackson's Latest Video! ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6730.1.85838738fbac462f0e2fcd8981c330d5)
---
| | [ Watch This Video About James Lankford's Voting Record ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=11712058.6731.1.8c6e66b2c5567ec1dd3ffe105f2eb6a5)

Dear
Fellow American,

You may
be shocked to learn that thousands of public schools have
recently banned a classic American story.

Even if
you haven't read the book, you know the name. It's The Adventures
of Huckleberry Finn by Mark Twain.

Unfortunately, political correctness has taken this literary
classic out of the hands of far too many young Americans.

But here
at Hillsdale College, we're working to safeguard the legacy of
this treasured classic, along with the legacy of the man regarded
by many as America's greatest author.

That is
why I want to offer you a special DVD box set of our fascinating
and important online course, "Mark Twain: Tom Sawyer, Huckleberry
Finn, and Selected Short Stories."

Twain's
realist fiction reveals timeless truths about human nature. And
while American life has certainly changed since the 1800s, human
nature has not. So these literary works are as relevant and as
important as ever.

Now, we
have created a special DVD version of our course that includes
all nine lectures. And today, I'd like to send you this DVD box
set as our way of thanking you for supporting our educational
outreach efforts on behalf of liberty with a tax-deductible gift
of $100 or more.

Only a
limited number of these DVD sets are available, so I hope you'll
take this opportunity to add it to your personal library or give
it as a gift-before they're gone (or removed from your local
library!).

You can
use this secure link to get your copy of "Mark Twain: Tom Sawyer,
Huckleberry Finn, and Selected Short Stories" on DVD:

https://secure.hillsdale.edu/support-hillsdales-online-courses-mark-twain

Warm
regards,

Bill
Gray, '01
Vice
President
National
Donor Outreach
Hillsdale
College

P.S.
Another great author, Ernest Hemingway, once said, "All modern
American literature comes from one book by Mark Twain called
Huckleberry Finn." Don't let this classic disappear forever.

Get your
DVD box set of "Mark Twain: Tom Sawyer, Huckleberry Finn, and
Selected Short Stories" right now when you make a tax-deductible
gift of $100 or more at this secure link:

Bob

subject: I'm The Democrat Challenging Scott Perry
body:
www.danielsforcongress.org [www.danielsforcongress.org]
In the last week, you've heard a lot about my opponent, Scott Perry, the Republican Congressman called out during last week's Jan. 6 Committee hearing for seeking a pardon from Donald Trump for his role in the insurrection, but you may not have heard much about Perry's opponent.
I'm Shamaine Daniels, the Democrat challenging Scott Perry in November. I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself, and I wanted to ask for your help.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q6EM89Va1XA [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q6EM89Va1XA]
The stakes are high in this election. Scott Perry is one of the most dangerous members of Congress. You already know about his role in the plot to overturn the election, but Perry's story doesn't end there.
With his recent election as the Chair of the Freedom Caucus - the most extreme, far-right faction in the House, he’s more dangerous than ever. Scott Perry is an embarrassment to all Americans. He MUST be stopped, and we CAN stop him.
PA-10 is the best opportunity to flip a Pennsylvania Congressional seat from Red to Blue in 2022. Click here to make a contribution to flip this seat and defeat Scott Perry [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
I’m a different type of candidate than we have run against Scott Perry in the past. My family moved to this country from Venezuela when I was 13. My Mom worked hard and gave us a good life. I worked hard too. I went to college, then law school and became an attorney fighting for civil rights, workers’ rights, and immigrants.
In 2013, I was elected to Harrisburg City Council. Now in my third term, I’ve worked hard fighting for many of the same constituents whom I will represent in Congress. On City Council, I led the effort to help small businesses open with less red tape and lower fees, and fought for affordable, habitable housing.
If you want to defeat Scott Perry and invest in an experienced candidate who will also bring a fresh perspective to Congress, we need your help. Click here to support our campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
I’m also a mom who worries about my daughter’s future. I want my daughter, and all of our children, to grow up in an America where she is treated equally and paid fairly, a country where her voice and her vote matters, and where she has more and better opportunities to build the life she wants. I also want to leave her a world that isn’t threatened by climate change and where the water is safe to drink and the air is safe to breathe.
If you share these priorities. If you want your children and their children to grow up in a country, and a world, where the future is bright, CLICK HERE to make a contribution and join our team. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/daniels-email]
I hope you’ll support my campaign so we can defeat my dangerous opponent and work together to create the America we all want to see.
With Gratitude,
Shamaine

body:
I officially have five extreme GOP opponents running against me.
| | |
---
This is important –
I officially have five extreme GOP opponents running against me.
With Roe v. Wade on the verge of being overturned, it's up to the Senate to safeguard access to abortion. But every single one of my opponents would be a rubber stamp for Mitch McConnell's extreme agenda. Just take a look for yourself:
📌Kevin Smith has been an anti-choice activist for decades and said, "**We are SO close to ending abortion once and for all** ," when the draft Roe v. Wade decision was leaked.
📌Chuck Morse spearheaded New Hampshire's first abortion ban in modern history and explicitly said **he opposes ANY exceptions for rape or incest.**
📌Don Bolduc criticized New Hampshire's abortion ban for **not being restrictive enough.**

body:
Dear Peter,

I'm worried.

In 6 of the 8 top battleground states, _Democrats outraised Republicans in the first quarter_.

Including right here in Florida!

| | Hi Peter, After Donald Trump was elected in 2016, I set out to learn more about where our country was headed. So, I spent three months driving 12,000 miles in a borrowed RV that I named Lucille. I talked with people who’d probably never had a conversation with a Black woman before. They shared stories about the skyrocketing cost of insulin. In return, I shared my story about paying for the multiple sclerosis meds that keep me in good health. When COVID rocked our country and shed light on the inequities that many tried to ignore — income, education, justice, and more — I knew we could do so much better. **That’s why I’m running for Congress, Peter.** The great people of Maryland’s Fourth Congressional District deserve better. Our district simply is not getting our fair share from Washington, but _**I’ve got the experience and fight in me to fix that. **_ I was the first Black woman to represent Maryland in Congress and I’m ready to head back to the House to deliver. I’m bringing the clout and experience to ensure our district has a seat front and center of the table where the decisions are made. When I represented MD-4 from 2008-2017, I worked across the aisle to bring thousands of jobs to Maryland, fund HBCUs at historic levels, and expand STEM education in our classrooms. I’m running now to build on the victories I won for this district and deliver on things that really matter to our community: Medicare for All, environmental justice for our communities, criminal justice reform, and securing the voting rights of every single one of us. It’s time we make the wealthy finally pay their fair share, so we can start bringing down the cost of living for our families. I’m prepared to take on this fight, but I need your help. We’re organizing a grassroots movement from Fort Washington to Annapolis and everywhere in between and I’m counting on supporters like you. **[The clock is ticking. With the primary election just a few months away, I hope you’ll join us in this fight today to amplify our district’s voices in Congress.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46542902/350725708/-983458636?source=ldr_welcome_em1_web&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NTE2MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMmJkNjBlNy1iN2VjLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=3tjnqv6Lx39J9sMcNAve3quQivupmwiR-YveSo8wTe0=&emci=2d7df84f-cea3-ec11-a22a-281878b85110&emdi=12bd60e7-b7ec-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=14034724) **

clean_body: We’re organizing a grassroots movement from Fort Washington to Annapolis and everywhere in between and I’m counting on supporters like you.| | | | | Hi Peter, After Donald Trump was elected in 2016, I set out to learn more about where our country was headed. So, I spent three months driving 12,000 miles in a borrowed RV that I named Lucille. I talked with people who’d probably never had a conversation with a Black woman before. They shared stories about the skyrocketing cost of insulin. In return, I shared my story about paying for the multiple sclerosis meds that keep me in good health. When COVID rocked our country and shed light on the inequities that many tried to ignore — income, education, justice, and more — I knew we could do so much better. That’s why I’m running for Congress, Peter. The great people of Maryland’s Fourth Congressional District deserve better. Our district simply is not getting our fair share from Washington, but I’ve got the experience and fight in me to fix that. I was the first Black woman to represent Maryland in Congress and I’m ready to head back to the House to deliver. I’m bringing the clout and experience to ensure our district has a seat front and center of the table where the decisions are made. When I represented MD-4 from 2008-2017, I worked across the aisle to bring thousands of jobs to Maryland, fund HBCUs at historic levels, and expand STEM education in our classrooms. I’m running now to build on the victories I won for this district and deliver on things that really matter to our community: Medicare for All, environmental justice for our communities, criminal justice reform, and securing the voting rights of every single one of us. It’s time we make the wealthy finally pay their fair share, so we can start bringing down the cost of living for our families. I’m prepared to take on this fight, but I need your help. We’re organizing a grassroots movement from Fort Washington to Annapolis and everywhere in between and I’m counting on supporters like you. Let’s do this together, Donna | | | | | Congresswoman Donna Edwards is a proven progressive leader and a fighter with the clout and experience to deliver for Maryland’s 4th Congressional District from day one. | | Peter,

_[But we need you today](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=f0a7886b91&e=33b11688c1) to **help us** compete with this machine. | | Peter, Make no mistake about it: our community is gripped in a public safety crisis – from burglaries to break-ins to auto theft. And I understand that times like these can rattle people's nerves; that's what I see in my opponents' one-dimensional impulsive responses to raise taxes or defund the police. But reactionary ideas don't solve problems. _Coalitions do._ **Peter, me be clear, I have never and will never support defunding the police. ** Here in Nassau County, I'm bringing together community stakeholders of all stripes to get on the same page and create a comprehensive solution to public safety issues. **I'll do the same in Congress** ; rather than spitting out the same excuses, retreating into partisan camps, or pointing fingers, I'll build unity around the solutions we all need, and that we know _work_ :
* Fully funding well-trained, accountable police departments.
* Creating a robust mental health care system, to support people who are struggling;
* Driving job creation to keep people from slipping into crime in the first place;
* Finally standing up to the gun lobby and getting weapons of war off our streets.

Again, knee-jerk, bumper-sticker ideas like "Defund the Police" won't make our streets safer, and leaders who hide behind them aren't really invested in solving problems; in fact, those plans only dig us deeper into the hole we're in. **That's why we've built this movement to fight for commonsense solutions and productive coalitions and put an end to the partisan gridlock in Washington.** All families deserve to feel safe in their home and community, Peter. **Everyone can agree on that. clean_body: | | | | Peter, Make no mistake about it: our community is gripped in a public safety crisis – from burglaries to break-ins to auto theft. And I understand that times like these can rattle people's nerves; that's what I see in my opponents' one-dimensional impulsive responses to raise taxes or defund the police. But reactionary ideas don't solve problems. Coalitions do. Peter, me be clear, I have never and will never support defunding the police. Here in Nassau County, I'm bringing together community stakeholders of all stripes to get on the same page and create a comprehensive solution to public safety issues. I'll do the same in Congress ; rather than spitting out the same excuses, retreating into partisan camps, or pointing fingers, I'll build unity around the solutions we all need, and that we know work : Fully funding well-trained, accountable police departments. Creating a robust mental health care system, to support people who are struggling; Driving job creation to keep people from slipping into crime in the first place; Finally standing up to the gun lobby and getting weapons of war off our streets. Again, knee-jerk, bumper-sticker ideas like "Defund the Police" won't make our streets safer, and leaders who hide behind them aren't really invested in solving problems; in fact, those plans only dig us deeper into the hole we're in. That's why we've built this movement to fight for commonsense solutions and productive coalitions and put an end to the partisan gridlock in Washington. All families deserve to feel safe in their home and community, Peter. Everyone can agree on that. It's time we had leaders who act like it. With Chairman Takano’s leadership of the House Veterans Affairs Committee, the work of Democrats in Congress to create jobs for our veterans has resulted in a record high veterans’ employment rate, House passage of “burn pits” legislation that provides veterans with cancer the care and support they have earned, and new suicide prevention resources to help save the lives of our veterans.
The first openly gay Asian American elected to Congress, Chairman Takano is committed to equality and opportunity for all – including in all aspects of our military. We are grateful for the opportunity to talk to him about the sustained focus of our President and of Democrats in Congress on remedying the harmful legacy and consequences of policies like DADT and DOMA on our servicemembers, veterans and their families with thoughtful implementation of new policies to ensure full LGBTQ inclusion and equality in our military.
Because Democrats understand that America’s military families also serve our country alongside their loved ones in uniform – we will also talk to Chairman Takano about how Democrats are ensuring that we understand their needs and are working to deliver solutions to ease their burdens.

clean_body: I know you care deeply about this race and defending our Democratic Senate majority | | | = I wanted to share an update on my race, team, and I hope you'll read this through to the end. A Suffolk University/USA Today Florida poll showed that I can win, but only if I reach more voters: in on-the-ground organizing, in fundraising, in voter registration – nearly every single way you can imagine. But I'm a few points behind Marco Rubio and the last Florida Senate race was decided by just 0.12 points. Does it worry me? Absolutely. Every dollar I fail to raise now means fewer resources I can pour into mobilizing voters and fighting back when Rubio's airing deceitful attack ads. It means the GOP and Marco Rubio inch closer to keeping Florida red and flipping the Senate. I know you don't want that to happen. I know you care deeply about this race and defending our Democratic Senate majority, and I appreciate that so, so much. But I simply will not have the resources it takes to compete – and most importantly, win – if I don't hit my campaign's fundraising goals. = | = = = = = = With so much gratitude, Val Demings | = Thank you for your dedicated support of The Democratic Association of Secretaries of State. We're the ONLY national organization dedicated to electing these state-level voting rights champions. There are 27 Secretaries of State races this year. We're fighting to reelect 13 Democratic Secretaries of State, win in battleground states, and flip red seats blue. But we're relying on grassroots supporters to provide us with the resources we need to win nationwide. = =

body:
Derek, this just changed everything: Adam Laxalt (R) is officially the GOP nominee for Senate here in Nevada, where he and I will face off this November in the race that will determine control of the Senate.
Keeping this seat and the Senate blue will come down to your grassroots support. So I’m urgently asking you: Will you split $27 or more right now between my campaign and CommonGood so we can keep Nevada and the Senate blue? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20220615_CGVA_CCM]
Your support right now could not be more important: The Cook Political Report, National Journal, and Roll Call have all named me the most vulnerable senator in America — and Nate Silver himself at FiveThirtyEight says this is the GOP’s best pickup opportunity.
Polling already shows me 3 points down, that’s why Mitch McConnell and his super PAC are about to unleash $18 MILLION on vicious attack ads to defeat me.
The first few days of the general election are crucial. But McConnell’s attacks will completely overwhelm us and drown out my voice in this vital moment – unless I can raise the resources to fight back. That’s why I set an ambitious general election fundraising goal, but with time running out before the midnight deadline, I’m falling dangerously short.
Please, Derek, I’m personally counting on you: Will you become a general election founding donor and help us hit this goal so we can defeat Adam Laxalt, win in Nevada, and defend our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_ccm?refcode=20220615_CGVA_CCM]

Laxalt has the entire force of the MAGA movement behind him, not only because he led the Big Lie conspiracy theories for Trump in Nevada, but because he would be a guaranteed vote on a national abortion ban.
This isn’t just about winning a Senate race — it’s about the future of our democracy and the values that we share.

Friend – This week, we reached a campaign milestone. We launched my very first TV ad to defeat Marco Rubio.

In a minute, I'm going to ask you to make a $5 donation to my campaign to keep my ad on the air – but first, give me a few seconds to explain why your gift right now is so important.
This ad will introduce this campaign to millions of Floridians who don't know me as well as you do – it talks about my 27 years in law enforcement and becoming the first woman to serve as Orlando's chief of police.
**I'm just a few points behind in this race, and I need everyone from the Panhandle to the Keys to hear my story – but I'm falling $15,671 short of what I need to keep this ad on the air _._ I have to close this gap before midnight, so please: [Will you donate $5 right now to help me reach my goal and share my story with more voters?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46549924/350758000/-892300846?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3539-fr-nd-v2&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZDJjNzk0OS1jNmVjLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JnbXlheiASth0acj_VgCsSuqbtOTseEhogjZvts4UtA=)**

Val Demings

Dear Friend, While many people are familiar with David as the shepherd boy who slew the giant, they likely don’t know his full story—especially the tragedies that befall his family and his beautiful turn to repentance. In fact, at its heart, the story of David is about fathers and sons.

King David’s momentous story provides profound insights into many of life’s most important questions, including: What are my responsibilities to God? What do I owe my fellow man? How do I lead my family? How do I turn away from sin? What is the best way to lead others?

Taught by Hillsdale College Professor of English Justin Jackson, **“The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King”** examines the Old Testament books of First and Second Samuel. This eight-lesson course explores David’s character and the consequences of his choices on his family and the people of Israel.
---
| | **This is why we’ve produced our online course, “The David Story: Shepherd, Father, King,” which is now available on DVD. And you can reserve your copy using this secure link:**

**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/david-story-dvd](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zq1pn4d6a02i16ptebsf96dhj7qt5jq5cb3vbrs8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cpi60or4c3h2bs)** By viewing the course, you’ll learn more about the nature of God, family, leadership, sin, and repentance; in short, you’ll learn more about what truly matters in life. **I hope you’ll reserve your DVD today and share its abiding lessons with your family and friends. The DVD is perfect for a Bible study or homeschool curriculum.**

The government's grip on the throat of its citizenry has grown so tight as to make our republic unrecognizable. When the COVID lockdowns came to Michigan and the "vaccine passport", and "rules for thee but not for me" crowd unconstitutionally locked us in our homes and closed businesses and took away our rights--I stood up. I stood up. And this is what happens when you stand up to tyranny in Biden's America. _I will never bend the knee to tyrants. I don't think you will either. _ There is a simple answer. We beat them. We beat them at the ballot box so badly that they can't cheat. They can't steal it. We beat them so badly that no government, no political party, no deep state operative _**will ever, ever forget the consequence of oppressing the will of the people**_ and attempting to steal our God-given rights. _I need_ _your_ _help_. [I need you to make a donation right now and help me fight back. I have no intention of letting up now. ](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c24313%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2frHb1db68UYCvA77Hsfl1Q&sysid=1) That they're trying to throw me in prison shows they're scared. You know what will scare them more? A war chest unrivaled in history. A war chest that says every man and woman across this country who believes in liberty and the rights of the people are standing arm-in-arm ready to defend those rights. You've probably never gotten a letter from a political prisoner, but you're getting one now. The question is: _What will you do next?_ Will you delete this email and go back to your day waiting around for them to take away your next freedom? Maybe your second and first amendment rights next? Or will you [click the link, make a donation, and be part of the true grassroots movement that is building here](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c24314%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=JfY3AZQjawHD8NfT%2bV4j9A&sysid=1)? I've made it clear where I stand. I will not back down. I will not stop defending OUR rights. Yours and mine. I need you to commit, right now. Click the link, make as generous a donation as you can. **They want us silent. They want us on our knees.** Stand up. Stand with me. Get involved right now, while there is still time.

name: Adam Kinzinger
subject: Playing with fire + 1/6 Digest
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Country First
body:
| [ ](http://www.country1st.com/?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=1)
---
Friend -- If I had to guess, I'd wager most members of Country First found their way to this movement because I've been one of the few leaders willing to call out my own party and President when they tried to overturn a free and fair election; when they let the ends of power justify the means of lies, conspiracies, and insurrection; when they put party over country. But I would be remiss if I did not call out the _other_ party when it joins the race to the bottom. The [_Washington Post_ reported on Monday](https://www.country1st.com/wapo_petition?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=2) that Democratic Party committees are funneling millions of dollars to support Trump-First Republican candidates running on a platform that promotes the Big Lie, undermines democracy, and defends the 1/6 attack on our Capitol. Why? Because Democratic strategists cynically hope that if a far-right MAGA candidate wins the Republican primary, it will be easier for a Democrat to defeat them in November. And while that _might_ end up working in a few races, particularly if this were a "Blue Wave" year (it's not), it's very likely that this will lead to even more far-right, authoritarian-friendly members of the U.S. Congress. Democratic leaders are playing with fire, and could ultimately be responsible for helping elect a pro-Trump majority. This is reckless and dangerous. Period. | [](https://www.country1st.com/wapo_petition?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=3 "Sign the Petition: Stop Playing with Fire!") [Sign the Petition: Stop Playing with Fire!](https://www.country1st.com/wapo_petition?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=3)
---
Look, I know some people won't like this email. But the point I'm here to make is that it's important for ALL of us, regardless of our party, to stand for what's right when our leaders, regardless of their party, do what's wrong.
After all, our parties are perversely designed to win at all costs. And as recent history has shown, some costs are far too high for a republic to bear.
Country First,
Adam
* * *
* * *
* * *
## 1/6 Committee Digest
Country First presents the next edition of The Digest to highlight the important work of the 1/6 Committee. Our aim is to make this available to our members within 24 hours after each hearing. **MARK YOUR CALENDARS FOR THE NEXT HEARING:** **THURSDAY, JUNE 16 AT 1 PM ET** **In Case You Missed It:**
* Rep. Kinzinger [takes his message to Fox News](https://www.country1st.com/cavuto_20220614?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=4), discusses 2024 and importance of truth in politics.
* Rep. Kinzinger speaks to CBS about [pardons](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRZXtpjTTpjlw7OP0G4bxNhk&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=5) and misinformation.

**Who Gave Testimony in Hearing #2:**
* **Bill Stepien** , former White House Political Director and Trump’s 2020 campaign manager, pulled out at the last minute after his wife went into labor.
* **Al Schmidt** , Philadelphia City Commissioner
* **Genjamin Ginsberg** , a top [Republican](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRZOnMzB1dZ1fr-ZhXsqYete&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=6) election attorney.
* **B.J. Pak** , former [Trump-appointed](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GQ96LxW7tJscudkL8mlwNzVEKXk7dMDJzwJlfbbiiRYWMBHtPzgl5h0q8js7eil0&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=7) federal prosecutor.

Here are the major developments from the committee: **(Drunken?) Guiliani Sets Up "A Coup in Search of a Legal Theory"** Monday’s hearing by the 1/6 Committee focused on former President Trump's refusal to accept both his own campaign's legal counsel as well as court decisions that his crafted narrative of voter fraud and a wrongful outcome were glaringly false. Instead, a "definitely intoxicated" Rudy Guiliani, as testified yesterday by senior campaign advisor, Jason Miller, gave Trump his [plan](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=qyDi432GwqzcezEbr9kAvxWz89SSAZT2fzIZLpVd4B7BeSFG6mRS0HNVCWRG9oFWk1r4ecg5EQ4ly38HrbrHVbBMNIj1CQUVWOdyQ1miYgZo4P7kQyRZdssR9y-b_m-c0w5ULvd2hUkMCIkSQ2ZZHA&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=8): Just say we won. According to recorded testimony from former Attorney General Bill Barr, Trump 2020 campaign attorney Matt Morgan, and campaign manager Bill Stepien, Mr. Trump was repeatedly advised that there was no evidence of any fraud or other activity that would change the election results. These conversations only angered the former President, who was determined to take "a different direction." Toward the end of the hearing, a screen of scrolling text displayed quotes by many of the judges who presided over court motions and arguments. In their rulings, none found any legal standing for overturning the 2020 election. Committee member Representative Zoe Lofgren (D-CA) added a [quote](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=As1eDYFfrpini3XkkXVkltOv6HFeNLRbPNrGu-WJeoZZO7gVtcNlPLfdhS8BL39kNPVrDzTgwWpAD3gKtqCAhvnZVk0JasDRCkoQeYwJqZc&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=9) by U.S. District Court Judge David Carter from a related ruling, saying that this is "a coup in search of a legal theory." Notably, many of the 61 cases that were dismissed or went against the Trump campaign were decided by Republican judges, including 10 appointed by the former President himself. Guiliani’s New York law license has since been [suspended](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=woKTkUvcgs1Qh0L7PRle5Yg8OcyEB9LDWHbfmI4N16S0cpwnYsyM6bkM0KLZYb31SXNQ2-tKKpffmcDx-E9o__XPvjkf47Vtp0mdOVsz2firVuaJoH8zk0B9FumD7VZsc35B98jMAZU8DuWl92HmMYZlkp0tpTC8sZ03pYJwNL9iXWm0BLts3aKXbJpzPRYA&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=10) and over 100 other attorneys are currently under or subject to investigation for bad faith and baseless efforts to undermine the outcome of the election. **Additional Testimony Alleges Trump Knew Voter Fraud Claims Were False** In a videotaped interview played at Monday’s special committee session, the former President’s Attorney General testified that he told the president [repeatedly](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=PiInCVHjZg_Lhb0RQ-dhd3nupceIa8DuTdOzvpYk6G2ZdiyCJ4lEl87fAGl54LrDtIpvRgjN2o8Q94WOvzZ1TTg_decjD83AyhjTRiNsnBKRMxz7X8qthbZK6Q3xfeLm6nNiV3wAZrDsE78G0oDZMCw_StEPyXAmfdWjgGqvZoXj6j4GhfsdKAYJBUwVfaEcAL9Y7U0NNVcIlGn1LQrH6VcN1I2Ufw3QXXiyEWfx1woRh1rN20ROerBBqJga9o1Y_BGMzkmV7AGbrc7aJf_e0Q&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=11) his claims of fraud were unfounded, but that there was "never an indication of interest in what the actual facts are." Barr thought the president had grown delusional when Trump insisted on investigating false claims. Barr later stated that he became increasingly worried about the former president’s state of mind and emphasized this in his quote: "I was somewhat demoralized, because I thought, 'Boy, if he really believes this stuff, he has lost contact with — he's become detached from reality if he really believes this stuff'." The committee has played Barr’s video testimony more than any other witness and these clips have established Barr as the highest ranking official in the Trump administration to disapprove of the President’s voter fraud allegations. Barr also said that Trump had zero interest in what the actual facts were and told the former President "the Justice Department is not an extension of your legal team." Despite the highest ranking legal official’s stance on election fraud, the former President continued to seek answers from others. Former acting Deputy Attorney General, Richard Donoghue, [claimed](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=_iXnL0bCffDuT3k_fuMSrNkmHdeFZMr6CLkST_LiOUkij3PDHIDL7M7VGi9vlu3PVJ-nV-hd72kmE8Md7G4WTGx1C1AGyik3MZO5ONZqABhGF9fO-fCZLG9fnMx5tyWhkBle5PwmJuahGphMujHi98AAfOGlvavxZVFhtmLqlAk&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=12) in a deposition played during today’s hearing that he told the former President the allegations of voter fraud during the 2020 presidential election were false and "pure insanity." In a pre-recorded testimony, Trump Campaign lawyer Alex Cannon, revealed that White House Chief of Staff Mark Meadows said, "so there’s no there there" when told there was no evidence of voter fraud. **Former Philadelphia City Commissioner Al Schmidt Recounts the Events and Trump Tweet That Led to MAGA Threats Directed toward Him and His Family** Al Schmidt, the former Philadelphia city commissioner, addressed the former President's claims about voter fraud in Philadelphia in his testimony at the second 1/6 Committee hearing. Such allegations consisted of ballots being cast by dead people, which Schmidt called "[absolute](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=cCXOak7nvsHDUNHmUT2roFiBmO5lhsFJ0ajrSaMvyaVpBexMl_IigRJKqwIcHPdfsBFWhQGAMS9v8BusQIrB8yTR7a1Z66M3-kE8g53f9gEd-BN9P3w1MavaaihjJhpjO2VEp7v4gpHqVktLwQoTIA&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=13) rubbish." In further disproving claims of election fraud, Schmidt challenged Rudy Guiliani's insistence that "8,000 dead people voted in Pennsylvania'' by asserting that "there wasn't evidence of eight." With further questioning by the committee, Schmidt explains that, due to a Trump tweet mentioning him by name, he received disturbingly "graphic" threats from Trump supporters that included the names of his family and home address, as well as photos of his home. One read, "Heads on spikes. Treasonous Schmidts." **Former Federal Prosecutor B.J. Pak Confirms His Investigation Found No Evidence of Voter Fraud in Georgia** At the second 1/6 Committee hearing, former United States Attorney B.J. Pak detailed the investigation into a supposed suitcase full of ballots cast for President Joe Biden. The investigation was tasked to him by former Attorney General Bill Barr after Rudy Giuliani, the now-suspended personal lawyer for the former President, presented a snipped video clip of vote counting to a Georgia state Senate Committee. Pak offered the investigation findings, which completely [disproved](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=EgoLP66qKbjSe1ZxerGwBFm7XblXQnv2VUdGkwQa9aqHyjOZoZeiretn-6_ZRWKIk31gD4Of2rI9OEgRK-8Ts_KCKz1xKSX8PiesSDYjmFBIZqcwqFtBlkx9UPReHclBndyPUDQ5u6Wy-55wJy-MmMOvnaSF-wqUcbuibbrMU78&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=14) the idea of there being a "suitcase" with ballots cast for Biden and confirmed that the object of interest was an official voter lockbox. In doing so, Pak asserted that the snippet Giuliani presented to the Georgia state Senate Committee consisted only of the part where the box was pulled out, excluding the parts of the video that confirmed it was a lockbox and not a suitcase. **Republican Election Attorney Benjamin Ginsberg’s Analysis of Election Lawsuits Reveals No Abnormalities** Prominent Republican election attorney, Benjamin Ginsberg, best known for his role in the 2000 Florida recount, testified regarding his [analysis](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=GjwzQmjoNJNKZ7-eUAZR_IHCWVZ2MFKcbC-8XoZf2I6uc_jto2EjarLQ1eEAL7xBLYuoR4Nc9-5Xcya0uHPZZdQHX96pY_C015pbeuDz3efz2lFeF2C799zQnlEiTTAtY1RtY6HqLFX0dU2qA7-C_0Om6FhovR3_KLsChCX_BVo&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=15) of Trump’s election lawsuits across the country. Of the 62 cases, 22 judges were appointed by Republican presidents, ten of which were appointed by Trump. Additionally, all three of Trump’s Supreme Court appointees rejected his fraud claims. Ginsberg stated that only half of the cases were dismissed, so roughly half of Trump’s cases "did have their day in court." The former President and his supporters often falsely claim their cases were never heard, or else they'd have been successful. **"Team Normal vs. Team Crazy" Split the Trump White House Post-Election** A previously unknown fissure of the Trump White House was exposed during Monday’s 1/6 Committee hearing. A series of the former President’s once-close aides testified of the split in the White House: Team Normal and Team Crazy. On "Team Normal," Bill Stepien, former Attorney General Bill Barr, and others who saw no path for a Trump second term. In a past [deposition](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=ByhkdA7RrYhHtdiUMWUYvDoU31aLiS3EgmUxpTQDTvEMx2C5x98l_xWj-4oSOTZ754TM3eZoC6IZ-gQXyqFnygQMRGsJmQmlLLRQQDd9i-nZIJgbz83cwNqePCgialyDvcWWW2gstGGHifZBJNPp3w&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=16), Bill Stepien, testified, "I didn’t mind being characterized as part of 'Team Normal'." After the election, the former President surrounded himself with Rudy Giuliani, Sidney Powell, and others who believed the election was stolen. Instead of accepting defeat, the former President and his new inner circle spun conspiracies, dug in their heels, and promoted the Big Lie. **Trump and His Allies Conned the Public out of $250 Million Dollars** The first week following the 2020 election, $100 million was raised by Trump, supposedly going towards "defending America" and fighting the alleged election fraud in court. The Trump Campaign ultimately [raised](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=oGkNRIpNU-65tzHrfmdwr6D_kCduNqBGfyUvQOoEwlwv5AJuc9LRYuZ9kPEY7CjvAZJmBpEEjo3AIofyobeTzXAqK_LQzUulV_V9E-uVEVubDlPCQ4vmbmyQKHG7kyUie3ePWozEe9QKVinhqNTHdw&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=wapo_petition_nd&n=17) over $250 million, rallying supporters around the idea that their hard-earned money was going toward winning back a "stolen" election. Instead, most of the money went to a PAC, some went toward Trump’s hotel group, and more still to other pro-Trump organizations. Very little, if any, went towards litigation of the 2020 election in key swing states. Rep. Lofgren detailed the many places the money went. Instead of being truthful about where the money was going, the former President and his allies lined their pockets off of a known and debunked lie that the election was stolen. "Not only was there the Big Lie," Lofgren said, "there was the Big Rip-Off."
* * *
**MARK YOUR CALENDARS FOR THE NEXT HEARING:** **THURSDAY, JUNE 16 AT 1 PM ET** _Country First is proud to release The Weekly Digest with important updates on the 1/6 Committee's investigation of the Capitol attack. If you would like to help contribute content to this newsletter, please e-mail[volunteer@country1st.com](mailto:volunteer@country1st.com)._

Barr later stated that he became increasingly worried about the former president’s state of mind and emphasized this in his quote: "I was somewhat demoralized, because I thought, 'Boy, if he really believes this stuff, he has lost contact with — he's become detached from reality if he really believes this stuff'." The committee has played Barr’s video testimony more than any other witness and these clips have established Barr as the highest ranking official in the Trump administration to disapprove of the President’s voter fraud allegations. Barr also said that Trump had zero interest in what the actual facts were and told the former President "the Justice Department is not an extension of your legal team." Despite the highest ranking legal official’s stance on election fraud, the former President continued to seek answers from others. Former acting Deputy Attorney General, Richard Donoghue, in a deposition played during today’s hearing that he told the former President the allegations of voter fraud during the 2020 presidential election were false and "pure insanity." In a pre-recorded testimony, Trump Campaign lawyer Alex Cannon, revealed that White House Chief of Staff Mark Meadows said, "so there’s no there there" when told there was no evidence of voter fraud. Former Philadelphia City Commissioner Al Schmidt Recounts the Events and Trump Tweet That Led to MAGA Threats Directed toward Him and His Family Al Schmidt, the former Philadelphia city commissioner, addressed the former President's claims about voter fraud in Philadelphia in his testimony at the second 1/6 Committee hearing. Such allegations consisted of ballots being cast by dead people, which Schmidt called " rubbish." In further disproving claims of election fraud, Schmidt challenged Rudy Guiliani's insistence that "8,000 dead people voted in Pennsylvania'' by asserting that "there wasn't evidence of eight." With further questioning by the committee, Schmidt explains that, due to a Trump tweet mentioning him by name, he received disturbingly "graphic" threats from Trump supporters that included the names of his family and home address, as well as photos of his home. One read, "Heads on spikes. Treasonous Schmidts." Former Federal Prosecutor B.J. Pak Confirms His Investigation Found No Evidence of Voter Fraud in Georgia At the second 1/6 Committee hearing, former United States Attorney B.J. Pak detailed the investigation into a supposed suitcase full of ballots cast for President Joe Biden. The investigation was tasked to him by former Attorney General Bill Barr after Rudy Giuliani, the now-suspended personal lawyer for the former President, presented a snipped video clip of vote counting to a Georgia state Senate Committee. Pak offered the investigation findings, which completely the idea of there being a "suitcase" with ballots cast for Biden and confirmed that the object of interest was an official voter lockbox. In doing so, Pak asserted that the snippet Giuliani presented to the Georgia state Senate Committee consisted only of the part where the box was pulled out, excluding the parts of the video that confirmed it was a lockbox and not a suitcase. Republican Election Attorney Benjamin Ginsberg’s Analysis of Election Lawsuits Reveals No Abnormalities Prominent Republican election attorney, Benjamin Ginsberg, best known for his role in the 2000 Florida recount, testified regarding his of Trump’s election lawsuits across the country. Of the 62 cases, 22 judges were appointed by Republican presidents, ten of which were appointed by Trump. Additionally, all three of Trump’s Supreme Court appointees rejected his fraud claims. Ginsberg stated that only half of the cases were dismissed, so roughly half of Trump’s cases "did have their day in court." The former President and his supporters often falsely claim their cases were never heard, or else they'd have been successful. "Team Normal vs. Team Crazy" Split the Trump White House Post-Election A previously unknown fissure of the Trump White House was exposed during Monday’s 1/6 Committee hearing. A series of the former President’s once-close aides testified of the split in the White House: Team Normal and Team Crazy. On "Team Normal," Bill Stepien, former Attorney General Bill Barr, and others who saw no path for a Trump second term. In a past , Bill Stepien, testified, "I didn’t mind being characterized as part of 'Team Normal'." After the election, the former President surrounded himself with Rudy Giuliani, Sidney Powell, and others who believed the election was stolen. Instead of accepting defeat, the former President and his new inner circle spun conspiracies, dug in their heels, and promoted the Big Lie. Trump and His Allies Conned the Public out of $250 Million Dollars The first week following the 2020 election, $100 million was raised by Trump, supposedly going towards "defending America" and fighting the alleged election fraud in court. The Trump Campaign ultimately over $250 million, rallying supporters around the idea that their hard-earned money was going toward winning back a "stolen" election. Instead, most of the money went to a PAC, some went toward Trump’s hotel group, and more still to other pro-Trump organizations. Very little, if any, went towards litigation of the 2020 election in key swing states. Rep. Lofgren detailed the many places the money went. Instead of being truthful about where the money was going, the former President and his allies lined their pockets off of a known and debunked lie that the election was stolen. "Not only was there the Big Lie," Lofgren said, "there was the Big Rip-Off." | | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, I feel like our culture has forgotten—or ignored—some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life. Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal. Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.** [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zoajeafh55liuc134bajg7hh1m7tgjcte6lv5aho_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cpi6ap34c9h2bs)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him. I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I’m not alone in this belief. I believe that you believe that too. I’ve started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. Friend, I'm going to be honest — we're in danger of losing two of the best and most effective educators in Congress: Katie Porter and Jahana Hayes. **Educator and Congresswoman Katie Porter received 51.3%** of the vote in the first round of balloting last week, and we know she's a top target of the anti-education, far right-wing Republicans. Republicans have raised and dedicated over $2 million to try to defeat her already, and we know there will be millions more dedicated to trying to kick her out of Congress. **National Teacher of the Year Jahana Hayes is a target of anti-education forces too.** Her opponent is being funded by the special interest group that has represented many of the worst for-profit colleges that ripped off students, leaving them with loads of debt and no good job prospects. The Obama administration tried to crack down on their worst offenses, but Donald Trump and Betsy DeVos bailed them out. Now, they are trying to defeat Jahana. [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46553757/350773832/723716001?refcode=20220615housefundc_gfx&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1NzI0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM5M2RmODc4LWQ0ZWMtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bXsme_lbrnLDMwY3UeggycytY3-sqVs7285XtP7SZsg=) Congresswomen Porter and Hayes need everyone's help if they are going to buck the tide and win re-election this year. So we're stepping up to help them out. We are just $2,719.95 away from being able to increase our contributions to inspiring educators running in competitive U.S. House races this year. | **[DONATE TODAY](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46553758/350773833/231552934?refcode=20220615housefundc_btn&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1NzI0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM5M2RmODc4LWQ0ZWMtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bXsme_lbrnLDMwY3UeggycytY3-sqVs7285XtP7SZsg=)**
