That's why we're working hard to support them, and why we're asking for your help today. [Please join us in contributing $5, $20, or whatever you can](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46553759/350773834/231552934?refcode=20220615housefundc_L1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1NzI0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM5M2RmODc4LWQ0ZWMtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=bXsme_lbrnLDMwY3UeggycytY3-sqVs7285XtP7SZsg=).

| | I’m no stranger to tough fights, friend. When I became Chief of Staff to President Obama’s auto task force, I kept hearing the same thing over and over again: “Let Detroit go bankrupt” and “You’ll never save those jobs.” But we got organized, fought back, and ended up saving two million jobs in the auto industry – 200,000 of which were right here in Michigan. While I loved working for the auto industry, I wanted to do more. I felt that I could make an even bigger impact, and do great things for my community. The decision I made to run for public office in 2017 ended up being one of the best decisions of my life. Don’t get me wrong, campaigning was never easy. From the minute I announced my campaign, skeptics doubted my ability to flip MI-11 blue. National Republicans spent millions against me. But I never gave up, and thanks to your support, I became the first Democrat elected to the district in nearly 100 years. I’ve loved every second serving as MI-11’s representative, which is why I’m running for re-election this year. I’m in for another tough race, but my work for the people of MI-11 is far from over. Team, Families in Arizona and across the nation are afraid — afraid to send their children to school or go to the grocery store, work, or their places of worship. It’s up to us to come together to help restore their sense of safety and security in their communities. I’m helping lead a bipartisan group of 20 senators to create a commonsense proposal to protect America’s children, keep our communities safe, and reduce gun violence across the country. This week, we agreed on a framework, an important step toward drafting legislation for the Senate to consider. Our proposal will save lives by:
* Increasing mental health resources
* Improving school safety and support for students
* Ensuring criminals and those declared dangerous to themselves or others do not have access to deadly weapons

Now, we are taking steps to build broad, bipartisan support so we can pass our proposal into law. [**It’s so important we have your support as we work together to get our bill written and on the Senate floor quickly. FROM THE DAILY HERALD EDITORIAL BOARD
Posted 6/7/2022 1:00 AM

This endorsement is a consensus opinion of the Daily Herald Editorial Board.

Six candidates are vying for the chance to represent Republicans in November for the 6th Congressional District. Three offer
especially intriguing candidacies.

Niki Conforti, an energy consultant from Glen Ellyn; Keith Pekau, a small-business owner and Orland Park mayor; and Gary Grasso,
an attorney and two-term Burr Ridge mayor with a long history of public service in DuPage County that includes two terms on the
county board, all present the possibility for an engaging matchup against whoever wins the Democratic primary.

They proudly and steadfastly espouse traditional Republican values of limited government and controlled government spending. And,
they offer reasonable and creative ideas on topics ranging from the aftermath of the Jan. 6 Capitol riot to climate change,
foreign policy, health care and immigration.

We favor Grasso. In addition to especially thoughtful approaches on difficult issues, he also boasts a range of public experience
that would serve him well as a U.S. congressman. Before moving to Burr Ridge, he served on the Thomas Ford Library Board in
Western Springs. He also spent 12 years on the DuPage County Board of Health and worked on Burr Ridge's environmental quality
commission before being elected a village trustee.

The depth and variety of these experiences suggest a background that will be valuable both in understanding the complexities of
the issues facing Congress and in working effectively with members of both parties.

Rounding out the field are attorney and engineer Scott Kaspar of Orland Park; Catherine O'Shea an Oak Lawn real estate broker; and
Rob Cruz, a general contractor from Oak Lawn. All offer various expressions of staunchly conservative positions that have little
chance of energizing moderates or winning over Democrats who may be disenchanted with the current direction of the party.

Grasso, however, presents an especially promising opportunity to mount a challenging and constructive campaign in November. He is
endorsed.

clean_body: Daily Herald Endorsement: Grasso in GOP primary for Congress from Dist. 6 [] FROM THE DAILY HERALD EDITORIAL BOARD Posted 6/7/2022 1:00 AM This endorsement is a consensus opinion of the Daily Herald Editorial Board. Six candidates are vying for the chance to represent Republicans in November for the 6th Congressional District. Three offer especially intriguing candidacies. Niki Conforti, an energy consultant from Glen Ellyn; Keith Pekau, a small-business owner and Orland Park mayor; and Gary Grasso, an attorney and two-term Burr Ridge mayor with a long history of public service in DuPage County that includes two terms on the county board, all present the possibility for an engaging matchup against whoever wins the Democratic primary. They proudly and steadfastly espouse traditional Republican values of limited government and controlled government spending. And, they offer reasonable and creative ideas on topics ranging from the aftermath of the Jan. 6 Capitol riot to climate change, foreign policy, health care and immigration. We favor Grasso. In addition to especially thoughtful approaches on difficult issues, he also boasts a range of public experience that would serve him well as a U.S. congressman. Before moving to Burr Ridge, he served on the Thomas Ford Library Board in Western Springs. He also spent 12 years on the DuPage County Board of Health and worked on Burr Ridge's environmental quality commission before being elected a village trustee. The depth and variety of these experiences suggest a background that will be valuable both in understanding the complexities of the issues facing Congress and in working effectively with members of both parties. Rounding out the field are attorney and engineer Scott Kaspar of Orland Park; Catherine O'Shea an Oak Lawn real estate broker; and Rob Cruz, a general contractor from Oak Lawn. All offer various expressions of staunchly conservative positions that have little chance of energizing moderates or winning over Democrats who may be disenchanted with the current direction of the party. Grasso, however, presents an especially promising opportunity to mount a challenging and constructive campaign in November. He is endorsed. Every North Carolinian deserves to be able to seek the care they need to get and stay healthy. body:
Exciting news from the campaign trail! The Phoenix Law Enforcement Association held an event today in which they announced their endorsement of Tanya | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/71ac876374e6/team-tanya-alert-former-senator-jon-kyl-endorses-tanya-wheeless-7237765?e=bd2b55b0e3)
---
| | |
---
| | | Hi Friend, Exciting news from the campaign trail! The Phoenix Law Enforcement Association held an event yesterday in which they announced their endorsement of Tanya in the AZ-04 congressional race, followed by Tanya joining Phoenix Police Lieutenant Calderon for a Ride Along.

“The Phoenix Law Enforcement Association confidently recommends and endorses Tanya Contreras Wheeless to represent the Fourth Congressional District. The board and members of the Phoenix Law Enforcement Association are confident that Tanya Contreras Wheeless will do an excellent job representing her Congressional District and the State of Arizona,” **said Phoenix Law Enforcement Association President Darrell Kriplean.** “The members have witnessed her professionalism, support for law enforcement and the positive impact she has on the community. The board concluded that Tanya is the most qualified and in the best position to win in 2022.”
[**Join the Phoenix Law Enforcement Association in Supporting Tanya by Liking and Sharing their Endorsement!**](https://tanyaforarizona.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e27b684e0e86fe5dbc580daeb&id=a46f8814b9&e=bd2b55b0e3)
---
| [ ](https://tanyaforarizona.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e27b684e0e86fe5dbc580daeb&id=248869353c&e=bd2b55b0e3)
---
| The Phoenix Law Enforcement Association joins Tanya Contreras Wheeless’ growing list of endorsements, including the Congressional Leadership Fund, Chair Elise Stefanik, Winning for Women, Senator Martha McSally, Senator Jon Kyl, Young Guns’ “On the Radar” list, VIEWPAC and Maggie’s List.

Best,
Team Tanya
---
| \--
More about Tanya:

**_Tanya Contreras Wheeless_** launched her campaign for U.S. Congress in August 2021. She is a proven leader with a track record of bringing people together to solve problems. Her vast professional experience includes lawyer, business association CEO, sports executive with the Phoenix Suns, small business owner, and community advocate.

A valley native, she was born to teen parents and is the granddaughter of immigrants. She grew up in a working-class family that often struggled, but despite the challenges, she learned the importance of faith, family, hard work, and personal responsibility.

Driven by her desire to create a better life for herself, Tanya worked from the time she was 14. She put herself through Arizona State University, becoming the first person in her family to graduate from college. She went on to graduate from ASU Law with distinction, earning a job at one of the nation’s top law firms.

Now, Tanya is ready to bring her experience and thoughtful leadership to Congress. She believes in the promise of the American dream and will fight to preserve it. She will embrace policies that empower people, not the government. And, she will always put Arizona first.

Tanya lives in Tempe with her husband Steve, an attorney and former F-16 pilot in the U.S. Air Force. They have three wonderful children and two dogs who keep them on their toes.

In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ --Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty--author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’--a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for--and opposition to--socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c24347%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fibXLcX4SlPGm4l8G4NJRQ&sysid=1)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”--including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory--which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race--are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c24347%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=fibXLcX4SlPGm4l8G4NJRQ&sysid=1)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember--**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

name: Matthew Diemer
subject: Roe v. Wade is set to be overturned
body:
Max Miller and his fellow Republicans want to regulate away a women’s right to control her own body. I’m going to Congress to protect Americans from having their rights stripped by the government. | |
---
Peter, The Supreme Court is getting ready to reverse over half a century of constitutional rights. It is a shame that in this day and age there are still people who want to erode women's reproductive rights. The decision upheld in Roe vs Wade has been settled for over 50 years, we should not have to spend our time fighting a fight that has already been won. This is a fight that we didn't ask for, but it's one that I am prepared to take to Congress. It is a shame that in this day and age there are still people who want to erode women's reproductive rights. A woman's right to choose is between her and her doctor. Max Miller and his fellow Republicans disagree. name: Harriet Hageman
subject: It's DISGUSTING to see Liz Cheney demonize conservatives. Help me FIRE Liz!
body:
This will be the most important race in the entire country...
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2z36o78uq3dp5p01msnl47pph8h9usnd5dvi25boo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk4qj4ttkumqn4s9nmorb79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onlm9p68d1m6mq7aslm6arb2or564qmcp1h69gect376hprasbgsph77d1kc9r60puie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6ccdkmmr3fclhcoqm1cr4suobapbi46h22sh2s8i66pb5cph68ob2cjh2bs)
This will be the most important race in the entire country... |
Friend,

Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-arm with Joe Biden?

No sooner had President Trump endorsed my primary challenge to Liz Cheney did she shoot back with her usual arrogance to "bring it."

[**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zf92knc4dkrhhj83b4pqjv5r9ps9gkb6s671df7g_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cph68ob2cjh2bs)
[DONATE NOW](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zf0rlsnv7c1c2n5l0k3n6uso2abrgl7vs98a7v10_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cph68ob2cjh2bs)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2ztr5gt90tn1aan0kbi3nkabmubqe16l8tjengv3g_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cph68ob2cjh2bs)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, **let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate - they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party... and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know - like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was duped by these same "Republicans."**

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2za84k0m5q81rnogtt5cc0cav3r4uudkaq2b4qu20_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cph68ob2cjh2bs)
[DONATE NOW](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zbv6ppcokp530habo2113m71934tntlchnl4d3s8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cph68ob2cjh2bs)
As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me.**

He knows the people of Wyoming - and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars_ , _fling open our borders_ , and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree!

**But even though I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement, there's one endorsement I still need: yours.**

[**Will you make an donation today to show President Trump that you're still a part of his MAGA-America First Movement?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zglntrjo5q8o9gglb25n1ao1qkcm50narms9f740_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cph68ob2cjh2bs)
[DONATE NOW](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zu99lgslfii8e1889f8llov76jiutoh45k00nkuo_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cph68ob2cjh2bs)
You should know that, even though polls show Cheney is grossly unpopular in Wyoming, she still thinks she can win re-election.

**In fact, when liberal _60 Minutes_ asked her if she could beat me in the primary, she said "absolutely...this is going to be the most important House race in the country."**

Well, she was right about something - this will be the most important race in the entire country - but only because it will be the first step in saving America from the big government elites who enable Joe Biden.

Again, I'll need your help to beat her.

As I said, Cheney can count on the deep pocketbooks of the entire establishment.

That's not even saying anything for her left-wing supporters, who see this as their chance to weaken our Republican Party for good.

**But with your help, I know we can beat them. And I know we can send the disastrous Cheney political dynasty packing for good.**

[**So please, won't you ensure that Liz Cheney bury me, a true conservative, with money from her swampy elite friends?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zd8si725afeej5jfdt93bdi7tegc2a6sqr5d66u0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cph68ob2cjh2bs)
[DONATE NOW](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zdara3n5kf6qlo7t9dbneuocl5fdhsgk70cv9uqo_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cph68ob2cjh2bs)
Liz Cheney represents everything the left stands for, and everything we must fight against.

Will you help me make sure we win that fight?

Respectfully,
[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zts7mt9pd3rss8885rlv1e1atuq44ace333qldh8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cph68ob2cjh2bs)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

P.S. It's disgusting to see Liz Cheney teaming up with George Bush to demonize conservatives and raise millions to back Nancy Pelosi's unconstitutional power grabs in Congress.

It's even more disgusting to watch her claim she speaks for the people of Wyoming and America.

[**No more - will you make an urgent donation to my campaign to defeat her in the Republican primary?**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zgdm5t5cjrguh79o5chrdshru57idff20fllhp4g_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cph68ob2cjh2bs)

[DONATE NOW](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zjkm76h6o7dki6pa9qh8h8s6iniitsnjtvi5bhho_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cph68ob2cjh2bs)

subject: They Didn't Expect This

body:
It has been a whirlwind of a week for the campaign.
| | | |
---
| Peter,
It has been a whirlwind of a week for the campaign.
As you may know, on June 9, the very day that the January 6 commission started its sham hearings, the FBI raided my house and arrested me in front of my small children, after giving a tip to NBC news about the raid.
I was charged with misdemeanors, and thankfully quickly released on bond.
Let that sink in. They raided my house for misdemeanors.
Little did they know that what they sought to use for evil, God is using for good.
Their actions have generated a groundswell of support for my campaign, from all over the country, as it became crystal clear that both the State and Federal government are using the brute force of the law to attack their political opponents.
They didn't expect this.

---
---
We have seen an unprecedented, coordinated effort this election season to eliminate Republicans, not just from the gubernatorial race, but from other local races.
A couple of days ago, Dana Nessel expressed her frustration at my momentum. She lamented,
"Frankly there is no way to keep him off the ballot, and if he were to win, it would be very difficult to remove him from office."
That's right, Dana. There is absolutely nothing you can do to stop what's coming.
My campaign is being inundated with calls asking me if I've dropped out of the race. If anyone tells you that I dropped out of the race, don't believe them.
One of my supporters received a call from a pollster:
---
---
Gretchen Whitmer and Dana Nessel are petrified, as they should be, because no scheming will stop the grassroots from electing a Governor who will put an end to shenanigans, and restore freedom to Michigan.
The Democrats will throw everything they have at me, including money from big donors.

name: =?utf-8?Q?Shawn=20Hyland?=
subject: Confronting partisan apostasy
body:
If you are like me, I cherish the national ties that bind our nation together. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/shawnhyland.com/abetteramericastartstoday-9084401?e=5167ed8367)
---
[](https://shawnhyland.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fadf394130a92311f650e3e36&id=f5ae8c8289&e=5167ed8367)
| | | | | | _Peter,_ America appears to be a deeply divided nation at its core. Our constitutional compact is tested every election cycle. Red states and blue states are in constant friction and competition. If a conservative state passes a law to reflect the will of their people, a progressive state will introduce a radical law that diametrically opposes the conservative state. It’s a game of public relations, political showmanship, and of course fundraising!It is easy to believe there are two different Americas that are fundamentally at odds with one another. And that any shared values or common culture America once had, has now been swept away by an influx of diverse ethnic and religious groups. That is simply not true.From inflation and gas prices to mental health and public safety; people from all political affliations are angry, frustrated, and scared with the direction that our country is currently heading. That’s why I ran on a platform of stronger families, safer neighborhoods, better schools, and more economic growth. **I know every society rises or falls based upon the health of these institutions.** Americans do not want to see broken and dysfunctional families, high crime rates, failing test scores, and high prices for consumer goods. _Even the democrats in San Francisco and New York City have realized that soft on crime anti-police rhetoric was doomed to failure from the start!_ Human nature would have it no other way _._ The tension America is currently experiencing is not the clash of an irreconcilable majority of citizens. It is the polarized fringes that both sides have entertained and have now empowered. Political parties are only as powerful as the broad coalition of groups they can assemble under one big tent. This has caused intra-party divisions between moderate and more ideological factions. As the internal party debates help develop a unifying platform of policy positions, it equally has moved the Democrat and Republican party further away from any middle ground that represents middle America.Therefore, when elected officials work together in negotiations and dialogue to take the best ideas from each perspective to pass a bipartisan bill, **they become guilty of what I term “partisan apostasy” – the perceived abandonment of their political party.** They are immediately condemned by ruthless, destructive, and vengeful voices on social media.I find this tragic. Finding solutions and the ability of Congress to get things done for the American people used to be applauded. Congressional approval ratings have been historically low because very little was accomplished. Now it’s the opposite. In stunning contrast, elected officials are insulted and demeaned for solving problems.**My friends, we must do better. If you are like me, I cherish the national ties that bind our nation together.** We should not appease the radical demands of the Far Left _or the Far Right_. We must not allow ourselves to become detached from our neighbors or isolated in our echo chambers. While I consider myself a strong conservative, I do not believe division and dishonesty is healthy to our nation, nor will it lead to the reconciliation so desperately needed.
---
|
---
| | | | | |
# Working for a Better America,
Shawn Hyland|

It's going to take **STRONG** and ethical leadership to bring our state back, but together, we can do this. **Learn more about where I stand** :
* **REBUILD FAMILIES** : Shift education funding to children and implement tougher penalties for crimes against children.

| | Peter,

With this heat wave hitting us, a night out on the water sounds nice!

I wanted to send a friendly reminder and provide some final details for our exclusive [Pekau for Congress Cruise](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=5440f0f199&e=7dd0b93d07) that is tonight at Burnham Harbor in Chicago.

**Tickets will be required** ahead of the event so if you were planning on attending but still need to get your ticket, [we have a few left so get your ticket here by 3pm today](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=090af039be&e=7dd0b93d07).

The cruise will take off at 7pm so make sure you arrive by 6:45pm. Find our [Pekau for Congress Cruise](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=76e5e82134&e=7dd0b93d07) at Dock J, Slip 24. [Directions and parking can be found here.](https://KeithPekau.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7e5f24fd5410f942bea909637&id=817eb78f02&e=7dd0b93d07)

**Once we're out on the water, a full dinner and bar will be available and the fireworks will begin from Navy Pier at 9:15pm.**

body:
We have some needs and hope you can help!

| Hey Peter! Christopher and Haylee here taking just a minute to let you know about a couple campaign needs. This will be short and to the point so please look below to see if there's anything you can help with: **Volunteer Meeting:** Last week we had a great group of volunteers gathered in Wasilla, Soldotna, and Ketchikan! After we had a short training, the volunteers went out to the community to do door-knocking and they reported a **great** response from Alaskans! **We will be gathering again this Saturday at 9am** in the same locations: Wasilla, Soldotna, and Ketchikan! **_Field Directors:_** If you live in the following areas and would like to facilitate a volunteer meeting, etc. please **text Jason at 907-232-9454** and let him know.
* Fairbanks/North Pole
* Anchorage
* Eagle River / Chugiak
* Valdez

**_Sign Locations_** - You'll start seeing our large signs popping up around the State soon! If you have a high-visibility location that we can place a large sign, one of our volunteers will bring one to you. **Text Jason at 907-232-9454** with your contact info and the sign location and he'll make sure someone gets one to you as soon as possible! **_Mileage Tickets -_** We have three supporters out-of-state who want to come join the campaign ground game here in Alaska! If you're able to contribute air miles or a flight ticket from Dallas to Anchorage, it would be super helpful! **Text Haylee at 907-232-9003** if you'd like to help in this way. Ok, that's it from us for now! Thanks for your help and your support! Christopher and Haylee Kurka PS. We are actively raising a LITTLE money from A LOT of grassroots donors from across Alaska to get our message out. For as little as $0.83 cents a day you can further our efforts to MAKE ALASKA FREE ! Prayerfully consider becoming a grassroots donor and donating $25 a month! To donate click the link > [https://www.chriskurka.com/donate](https://kurkaforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/r?u=HTIUaYWGgtW-Sq8jttULzW-zEK-3Z9mAZxjdCeR3iqLWUT4kcfhLZxsXf_4rl-GR&e=c3e286dcf444e6546a293f48f4c73831&utm_source=kurkaforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=action_items&n=1) [www.ChrisKurka.com](https://kurkaforgovernor.nationbuilder.com/r?u=HTIUaYWGgtW-Sq8jttULzZYHrXjSSqDZFm4adezdWWY&e=c3e286dcf444e6546a293f48f4c73831&utm_source=kurkaforgovernor&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=action_items&n=2) Paid for by Kurka for Governor PO Box 871181 Wasilla AK 99687.

But here’s what I do know... we can’t go on like this as a country. | Fellow American, A few years ago, I googled 'how to start a campaign'. I had no idea how to even start! And let me tell you something, I still have no clue what I’m doing. But here’s what I do know... we can’t go on like this as a country. People can’t afford to drive to work. Kids are being used as political pawns. American energy is being suppressed. Our border is open. Babies are starving due to a baby formula shortage. And our political 'leaders' are making excuse after excuse, without a single real solution. When I decided in 2019 to jump into a major swing race against a well-funded Democrat, I had no resources, knowledge, or background in politics – I didn’t even have a campaign manager! All I knew was that somebody had to step up and save our country, for our children’s sake. As it turns out, other Americans were on the same page as me. My message resonated with people, and we ran a historic campaign in one of the closest races in the country, losing by less than 10,000 votes. ...and it all started with an idea and a google search. I’m running to unseat the same Democrat once again – and just like last time this is going to be a tight race. Democrats and Republicans alike are watching this race like a hawk, because it’s the key to the House majority. if Republicans are going to retake control of the House, then it’s essential to win seats in suburban districts like the one I’m running in. ---
Hello,

My team and I talk a lot about the number 1,017.

1,017 is the number of votes we won by in 2016. We talk about the number a lot because it’s a good reminder of just how close our race this year will be.
For me, it’s also a reminder of the Granite Staters I fight for every day in the Senate. Those 1,017 voters – and the rest of the 1.3 million people in the state – are all folks who deserve a fair shot at getting ahead and staying ahead. They deserve reproductive rights, clean air and water, good paying jobs, and so much more.
If we hadn’t turned out those 1,017 voters, Democrats would not hold the Senate majority today.
With so much on the line, 1,017 votes is too close for comfort.

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46566755/350805991/396464211?refcode=em-logo&refcode2=18fcede3-eaec-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&contactdata=Ut6cH6iyq1CaJsgs6QQoARPN4c5uFlfMmJNlQzWVqhz21EGR%2F8kQUjF8mlWZ%2Fl8o&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxOGZjZWRlMy1lYWVjLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=k3_6veqKuFrDDqdhKNmQoPouebDq_x_9-XlPgKEeeUY=)
Over the weekend 31 masked members of a white supremacist group were arrested in Coeur D’Alene, Idaho on suspicion of conspiring to riot at the city’s annual Pride event. The citizen caller that raised the alarm told police he’d seen a group “looking like a little army”. In fact they were members of the ‘Patriot Front’ a branch of the ‘Unite the Right’ hate group that led the violent 2017 march in Charlottesville.

name: Del. Jazz Lewis
subject: Endorsement of Wes Moore For Governor
body:
Hello Folks!
I joined Delegate Andrea Harrison and Christopher Stevenson yesterday to endorse Wes Moore as Maryland's next governor. We toured a non-profit grocery store, for which I helped secure funding for, that is addressing the needs of a food desert, in Seat Pleasant, Maryland. With Wes as our state's chief executive, we will have a partner to help us deliver innovative and responses the problems most critical to Marylanders.
Our state government needs bold and visionary leadership to meet the current moment. Whether that is bringing more fresh food options to food deserts, expanding access to quality medical care, or tackling the racial wealth gap; we can't wait to make the necessary changes. That is why I am on Team Wes. Together, we will promote the policies to build a better Maryland for everyone.
Best Regards,
Jazz (Delegate, District 24)

| | Peter, Let's follow the problem, step-by-step. **Gun violence is ripping communities across our country apart. From the mass shooting at Thurston High School here in Springfield 24 years ago, to Columbine, to Sandy Hook, to Parkland, to Uvalde. Friend,

On Tuesday, The Washington Post [https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2022/06/14/more-than-100-gop-primary-winners-back-trumps-false-fraud-claims/] reported on the wave of Big Lie supporters running for office this year. These candidates are running on a web of lies from questioning President Biden’s victory to recasting the January 6th attack. The Post’s report shows just how pervasive these narratives are in races around the country.

And care to guess which Secretary of State race they focused on?

If you guessed Michigan, you’d be right. That’s because our opponent Kristina Karamo has been screaming about so-called “fraud” since 2020 and has never offered up any evidence to back her claims.

These aren’t some fringe candidates with no chance of winning. The Post points out:

“The majority of the election-denying candidates who have secured their nominations... are likely to win the offices they are seeking.”

More extremists won in Tuesday’s primaries around the country. They have real shots at winning.

The good news: right here in Michigan, Jocelyn’s got a great chance of beating an election denier and winning re-election. You recently heard from Dan that we have a clear path to victory this November. We can hold the line in one of the most important elections in Michigan’s history, and the implications for 2024 are clear.

It’s simple: we’re running against a Trump-endorsed conspiracy theorist who, if elected, would abuse her power. This isn’t about relitigating 2020 – it’s what Karamo’s going to try to do to our elections in 2024. When Trump picks up the phone and asks her to “find me some votes” – what do you think Karamo’s answer will be?

We cannot let our guard down, friend. This race will determine the future of election security in Michigan and the whole country is watching.

We need your support to win. It’s that simple. And there are many ways you can help make sure Jocelyn continues to be our Secretary of State.

ongoing support means we have the resources we need to reach voters and potential supporters who will help us win
3.
Spread the word:
-
the more people who know about Jocelyn’s historic impact and campaign to maintain election security in Michigan, the more likely we are to win

It might feel like we have a long way to go until Election Day but in reality, a lot of our grassroots work happens over the summer. So that means things are heating up - literally and figuratively - right now. Are you ready to step up, Friend? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/benson-landing1?refcode=061522nd]

Jocelyn is the last line of defense from Trump stealing the 2024 election. Let’s make sure we all have her back.

name: Del. Jazz Lewis
subject: Endorsement of Wes Moore For Governor
body:
Hello Folks!
I joined Delegate Andrea Harrison and Christopher Stevenson yesterday to endorse Wes Moore as Maryland's next governor. We toured a non-profit grocery store, for which I helped secure funding for, that is addressing the needs of a food desert, in Seat Pleasant, Maryland. With Wes as our state's chief executive, we will have a partner to help us deliver innovative and responses the problems most critical to Marylanders.
Our state government needs bold and visionary leadership to meet the current moment. Whether that is bringing more fresh food options to food deserts, expanding access to quality medical care, or tackling the racial wealth gap; we can't wait to make the necessary changes. That is why I am on Team Wes. Together, we will promote the policies to build a better Maryland for everyone.
Best Regards,
Jazz (Delegate, District 24)
BY AUTHORITY FRIENDS OF JAZZ LEWIS, CHRIS TAITT, TREASURER
Friends of Jazz Lewis - State Account
P.O. Box 341854
Bethesda, MD 20827
United States

body:
Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zsdai0pcuod3fdjkq648887ndkjt5n5avo3p9umo_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkorr7djl69pn8cbkmdqj6drh6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfdddn6krr7dlgeaqn0p33eapj2sr26dpn8cpksthrepbh6up3ddtm61gb9cbke3jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor9ddm6upb0pjksspm0ptgmlin48d245p25oh4cdimapj2c3h60o324no)
*Sponsored Message*
[](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z9k92j8ikvkku8l82ua5u47cdkntmagiro4msks8_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cph61oj0c1h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z06kkpeqemepf3ps8ru0s2n18ek43c5ct9g1le1o_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cph61oj0c1h2bs)** For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics--too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty--including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America 's future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I 've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z4r657q73t9kumkrqj6hgt7u0770hrqmgm91ecv0_rp22sh2s8i66pb5cph61oj0c1h2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention--and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

The Kiel Area School District, situated in a town of about 4,000, accused the three eighth graders of “Mispronouning” in a music classroom. == == The Epoch Times Capitol Police Lt. Friend,

Democrat Tim Ryan is in a dead heat race for Ohio’s open Senate seat and
he needs our help.

You might not know this, but I was born into a blue-collar family in
Springfield, Ohio. My dad was a factory worker. My mom was a tailor. And I
got my start in music singing in the church choir.

I’ve never forgotten where I come from—I know the challenges Ohio families
are facing, because my family faced them too. That’s how I know Ohio needs
Tim Ryan in the Senate.

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/14981?t=1010&amount=25&akid=4187%2E3611125%2Er2xtAF ]Republicans are spending millions and working overtime to defeat Tim.
Will you join me in supporting his campaign by making a contribution of
whatever you can to win this crucial race?

[ https://act.timforoh.com/go/14981?t=1011&amount=25&akid=4187%2E3611125%2Er2xtAF ]Donate

There’s a real struggle happening in our country between love and
fear—between advancing civil rights for everyone or stripping them away,
between treating refugees with compassion or as criminals, between lifting
up working families or continuing to punish poverty.

Republicans are actively working to take us in the wrong direction, down
the path of fear. If they take back the Senate, there’s no telling the
damage they’ll do.

Right now, Tim Ryan is neck-and-neck with his Republican opponent in a
race that will decide control of the Senate, and ultimately, the kind of
country we live in.

If you've got the time, volunteer! We've been in this race for over a year, and we've come a long way. From hosting community discussions on policy issues to healing from trauma, canvassing and texting voters, we've been About That Action for a long time. Now, I am asking you to go even harder these next two weeks. If you've got the time, volunteer! We've got a tonight at 6pm, and a on Saturday. We'll have ways to take action for the next two weeks, so keep an eye out for more ways to talk to voters! . Your donations are what keep our staff paid and our text banks running! We need your support if we're going to make it to the finish line, so please make a contribution if you can. Yours in service, Jahmal | "DONATE" | | | Huge thank you to everyone who showed up Monday night. There was a whole tornado but people showed up to watch "A Tiny Ripple of Hope" and ask us questions about the film. I also want to thank our volunteer Catherine and the people at Davis Theater who made this possible! It was a good reminder of why we're doing this--nonprofits shouldn't have to struggle, putting up their own money to make an impact. The solutions are so obvious when you're on the ground every day, and I know that we can help our communities thrive. And let me tell you something, I still have no clue what I’m doing. But here’s what I do know... we can’t go on like this as a country. People can’t afford to drive to work. Kids are being used as political pawns. American energy is being suppressed. Our border is open. Babies are starving due to a baby formula shortage. And our political 'leaders' are making excuse after excuse, without a single real solution. When I decided in 2019 to jump into a major swing race against a well-funded Democrat, I had no resources, knowledge, or background in politics – I didn’t even have a campaign manager! All I knew was that somebody had to step up and save our country, for our children’s sake. As it turns out, other Americans were on the same page as me. My message resonated with people, and we ran a historic campaign in one of the closest races in the country, losing by less than 10,000 votes. ...and it all started with an idea and a google search. I’m running to unseat the same Democrat once again – and just like last time this is going to be a tight race. body:
Dear Friend,

It’s unbelievable—and far worse than we thought.

Republican nominee for PA governor, Doug Mastriano, continues to compare America to Nazi Germany.

He did so when referring to gun laws to protect citizens. And now he’s done it in reference to the Jan. 6 attempt to overthrow our democracy—a violent insurrection that he literally participated in!!

On a recent podcast, he said the insurrection was a false flag operation, similar to the Reichstag fire in 1933, which the Nazis used to justify suspending civil liberties and to attack their political enemies.

Now, we have huge issues with throwing around the word Nazi, and with Nazi comparisons generally. But to flip the switch like this in an effort to make insurrectionists—among whom were Nazi sympathizers!!— into the victims...

This is the kind of Trumpian political pontificating that has allowed these traitors to begin dismantling our democracy.

Please stand with us to make sure this insurrectionist isn’t elected governor. Help us as we mobilize and invigorate the progressive movement and vote here in PA.

This is the kind of Trumpian political pontificating that has allowed these traitors to begin dismantling our democracy. Please stand with us to make sure this insurrectionist isn’t elected governor. Help us as we mobilize and invigorate the progressive movement and vote here in PA. [] Let’s fight together. body:
| Hi Peter, Meteorologist and Democratic candidate for Congress (IL-17) Eric Sorensen here. These days it seems like we are often living in a different world from some of our neighbors. Folks’ reactions to the events on January 6th show that. For 20 years, I was trusted to bring severe weather information to the people of Northwest Illinois. And if you’ve never lived here, I need to explain: tornadoes, floods, derechos, icy roads – these are all regular factors in our neck of the woods (and exceedingly becoming more common with climate change). My job was more than just the daily temperature and likelihood of rain. And I took it seriously, _very seriously_ , as lives were at stake. So how does my background connect into what we’ve seen in the Jan. 6th committee hearings? I’m horrified with the insurrection and attempted coup on our country’s democracy. And I wish everyone in my community felt the same way... but they don’t. I can’t promise that I’m going to be able to talk through the partisan noise, but I can tell you that I have been doing it here for the past two decades. Throughout this campaign, I’ve spoken with countless Republicans who say they’re pulling a Democratic ballot for the first time in their lives to vote for me. _Why_? **Because they trust me**. Here in Northwest Illinois voters are going to support the candidate who’s guided by science, who’s willing to speak to every voter across the district, and who’s been a trusted voice on TV in the district for the past 20 years. Will I be able to talk about January 6th to people that don’t see the insurrection as a problem (or who don’t even believe it was an insurrection)? I can’t promise you I’ll be successful, but I am going to try. And we know that any partisan-motivated elected official doesn’t have a chance in doing that. Peter, there is so much on the line this year. And we’re trying to do something _**different**_ – taking the community’s trusted meteorologist who’s been a staple on TVs across the district for 20 years and sending him to Washington to represent the community. I need your help to do just that: [secure.actblue.com/donate/es-june-em](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46556413/350784025/758105924?refcode=genemjune15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwOTdhNjgzOC1kY2VjLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FJfrNIOKVKF6iE81D0UDB6t6wv7xM02DNtywqO8TKE4=) Thank you for your support.
\- Eric \--

clean_body: | Hi Peter, Meteorologist and Democratic candidate for Congress (IL-17) Eric Sorensen here. These days it seems like we are often living in a different world from some of our neighbors. Folks’ reactions to the events on January 6th show that. For 20 years, I was trusted to bring severe weather information to the people of Northwest Illinois. And if you’ve never lived here, I need to explain: tornadoes, floods, derechos, icy roads – these are all regular factors in our neck of the woods (and exceedingly becoming more common with climate change). My job was more than just the daily temperature and likelihood of rain. And I took it seriously, very seriously , as lives were at stake. So how does my background connect into what we’ve seen in the Jan. 6th committee hearings? I’m horrified with the insurrection and attempted coup on our country’s democracy. And I wish everyone in my community felt the same way... but they don’t. I can’t promise that I’m going to be able to talk through the partisan noise, but I can tell you that I have been doing it here for the past two decades. Throughout this campaign, I’ve spoken with countless Republicans who say they’re pulling a Democratic ballot for the first time in their lives to vote for me. Why? Because they trust me. Here in Northwest Illinois voters are going to support the candidate who’s guided by science, who’s willing to speak to every voter across the district, and who’s been a trusted voice on TV in the district for the past 20 years. Will I be able to talk about January 6th to people that don’t see the insurrection as a problem (or who don’t even believe it was an insurrection)? I can’t promise you I’ll be successful, but I am going to try. And we know that any partisan-motivated elected official doesn’t have a chance in doing that. Peter, there is so much on the line this year. And we’re trying to do something different – taking the community’s trusted meteorologist who’s been a staple on TVs across the district for 20 years and sending him to Washington to represent the community. I need your help to do just that: = Thank you for your support. \- Eric \-- Eric Sorensen Meteorologist | Candidate for Congress (IL-17) 309-306-1717 = | * | = | Eric Sorensen is a former meteorologist born and raised in Rockford, IL running for U.S. Congress. One thing is crystal clear from the first two hearings: Donald Trump knew full well that the 2020 election was not stolen. Yet to this day, he continues to peddle the Big Lie to undermine our democracy.

Peter, January 6 was the beginning, not the end, of the GOP attack on democracy.

Republicans are making it easier for partisan officials to overturn the will of the people. They’re suppressing the right to vote. More than 100 winners of Republican primary elections endorse Trump’s Big Lie.

Democrats can no longer play nice in the sandbox with Trump Republicans. We need representatives in Congress who will stand up to the GOP.

#
> With Primary Day behind us, the race is officially on!
>
> I'm honored to be the Republican candidate in this fall's election to represent Maine in Congress. I take community service seriously and will do everything I can to earn the votes of my fellow Mainers.
>
> Thank you to all who have supported me so far. I constantly hear from voters across the district that Mainers are struggling and our leadership in DC is failing us. We can see the results of their failure: ridiculous gas prices, grocery prices are out of control, the stock market is plummeting and our international stature has been diminished.
>
> The current First District Congresswoman clearly is not focused on fixing these problems. Mainers - I'm asking for your vote because I know what you're struggling with and it's time for change in November.
>
> I also need your financial support. We can't push back on the progressive agenda without getting to Washington, and we need to continue raising money to put up a good fight. Please click the donate button and help get the next stage of the campaign going! Also, please share this email with friends and family!
>
> **The race is on!**
>
> Thank you,
> -Ed

Peter, the country
is experiencing historic heat waves right now. In at least 27 states,
historic high temperatures are threatening lives and power grids.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110578?refcode=em20220615-23859&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=23859%2E1203867%2EckJSQo ]New York Times headline reads It's going to be dangerously hot for 100
million Americans

"Dangerously hot" follows more frequent and more extreme flooding,
wildfires, and storms. It even follows record cold temperatures that
halted the power grid in Texas and killed hundreds of people.

Peter, it’s very
clear that we need historic action to address the climate crisis. It’s
very clear that we need a Green New Deal. Justice Democrats helps elect
leaders like AOC, Cori Bush, and Jamaal Bowman because they are the
leaders ready to fight for our people and our planet, while corporate
Democrats cater to Wall Street, Big Oil, and billionaire donors.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110578?refcode=em20220615-23859&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=23859%2E1203867%2EckJSQo ]Contribute $3 today to help us expand the Squad and
elect more leaders who will fight for a Green New Deal. We cannot give in
to the political establishment — the status quo is too disastrous for too
many people.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110578?refcode=em20220615-23859&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=23859%2E1203867%2EckJSQo ]Contribute

Now is the time for a comprehensive, once-in-a-generation mobilization
that prioritizes front-line communities, combats the climate crisis, and
creates millions of good-paying union jobs. A Green New Deal will
transition away from fossil fuels and dramatically expand existing
renewable power sources with the goal of meeting 100% of national power
demand through renewable sources.

This big, bold policy also provides people across the country with the
opportunity, training and education needed to participate fully and
equally in a green economy, offering jobs to help rebuild our crumbling
infrastructure. It ensures a just transition for all workers, low-income
communities, communities of color, and indigenous communities.

The Justice Democrats in Congress, like AOC, Cori, Jamaal, Rashida Tlaib,
Ilhan Omar, and Ayanna Pressley, know our only choice is a Green New Deal.
All while corporate Democrats and the political establishment try to stand
in our way. It’s why we must elect more Justice Democrats this
year, Peter.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/110578?refcode=em20220615-23859&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=23859%2E1203867%2EckJSQo ]Can you chip in to help us expand the Squad? Our fight for a Green New

against fossil fuel executives and corporate Democrats.

Stay safe during these heat waves, and thank you so much for your support.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Banning so-called "bathroom" bills as violations under equal protection laws, and banning all discriminatory laws that target LGBT Americans as a protected class. 5\. Protect the rights of all adults - married, single, straight, gay - to adopt children, to serve as foster parents, and to have access to all facilities, businesses, and locales regardless of sexuality or gender identity.

| June is National Pride Month, an opportunity to celebrate and uplift our LGBTQ+ friends, family, and community members! While San Diegans hold our own Pride in July, I’ll never pass up an opportunity to celebrate our community’s vibrant and diverse LGBTQ+ community. This month marks a celebration of community, love, and recognition of the LGBTQ+ trailblazers that came before us. Although this month we celebrate how far we’ve come, we are also reminded of the work that remains to be done.

As we recognize the progress we’ve made, we must also recommit ourselves to the work that remains to be done. Across the country, we are seeing a rise in discrimination and violence against the LGBTQ+ community, and state legislatures are advancing bills targeting transgender people. I promise you that I will never stop upholding and defending the rights of the LGBTQ+ community here in San Diego and across the country.

I am proud to be an original co-sponsor of the Equality Act. This landmark piece of legislation passed the House with bipartisan support over a year ago, but it has yet to pass the Senate. While San Diegans hold our own Pride in July, I’ll never pass up an opportunity to celebrate our community’s vibrant and diverse LGBTQ+ community. This month marks a celebration of community, love, and recognition of the LGBTQ+ trailblazers that came before us. Although this month we celebrate how far we’ve come, we are also reminded of the work that remains to be done. As we recognize the progress we’ve made, we must also recommit ourselves to the work that remains to be done. Across the country, we are seeing a rise in discrimination and violence against the LGBTQ+ community, and state legislatures are advancing bills targeting transgender people. I promise you that I will never stop upholding and defending the rights of the LGBTQ+ community here in San Diego and across the country. I am proud to be an original co-sponsor of the Equality Act. This landmark piece of legislation passed the House with bipartisan support over a year ago, but it has yet to pass the Senate. | I am continuously inspired by the resiliency and determination of my constituents and incredibly grateful for your support. | On January 6th, 2021, violent rioters stood outside the Capitol building, calling for the head of Vice President Mike Pence. And despite Pence's historically questionable judgment, he knew the truth: **Trump lost the election.** And while he defended our democracy, the insurrectionists, inspired by Trump, chanted, _“Hang Mike Pence!”_

And what was Trump’s response to these threats against his Vice President? _“Mike Pence ‘deserves it.’”_
---
| | **"There is no doubt that President Trump was well aware of the violence as it developed."**
\- Representative Liz Cheney
---
| [FIGHT BACK ](https://click.everyaction.com/k/46562530/350793143/1614996473?refcode=BLU-FFP-20220615-em-1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNS8xLzc3NDA2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM3Y2ViNDE4LWUyZWMtZWMxMS1iNDdhLTI4MTg3OGI4M2Q4YSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=XWlpXonbdwaHkqluMLm-Ae8t_AIbyyJkM0etGiHybL4=)

Hello,
Well, that didn’t take long. **Less than an hour after I was declared the Democratic nominee for Senate in Iowa, the attacks from Chuck Grassley began.**
_“The most liberal nominee in Iowa Senate history”
“Radical”
“Socialist”_
Gotta love it!
Chuck Grassley doesn’t know what to say about me. He’s never faced an opponent like me before. I’m his political nightmare, so he’s just throwing cow pies at the wall and hoping something sticks.
Calling me “radical” is laughable when Chuck Grassley supports a complete ban on abortion and letting literally anyone buy an AR-15 without even a background check. **But there’s one attack that I absolutely won’t take lying down, and that’s Chuck Grassley’s attacking me for serving our country for 36 years in the U.S. Navy.**
Grassley is already trying to say that because I enlisted in the military at age 19, because my deployments meant that my family had to move from state-to-state and country-to-country... that I’m not an Iowan anymore.
Chuck Grassley wants to pretend that I wasn’t raised in rural, northwest Iowa. He ignores the enormous sacrifices that my family – my wife and my kids – made to allow me to serve in the Navy.
**Grassley’s attacks denigrate every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, spend holidays away from each other, and be absent from life’s big events like weddings and the birth of a child.**
**And if Chuck Grassley thinks that I will stand silent while he says that every Iowan who puts on our country’s uniform stops being an Iowan... he’s delusional.**
These are the kinds of attacks I’m going to be up against. Nasty stuff from Chuck Grassley, Mitch McConnell, and the Fox ‘Entertainment’ News propaganda network.
There’s one reason why: The GOP is scared. They’ve seen the polls, and they know that if we defeat Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, Democrats are guaranteed to maintain our Senate majority.

body:
| | | |

|
---
|
# Bruce Davey Endorsement
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
(June 10, 2022) Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from President of Aviation Efficiency Group and former Blue Angels pilot, Bruce Davey.

Bruce Davey graduated from the United States Naval Academy then became a Navy fighter pilot and Blue Angel demonstration pilot. Following his Naval service, Davey was a pilot for a major US airline and consulted as an auditor at ARGUS, where he worked with a team to complete International Operational and Safety Audits of airlines around the world assessing compliance with International Air Transport Association (IATA) standards and recommended practices.

As the current president of Aviation Efficiency Group (AEG), Davey provides aviation businesses and related component sectors with insight, consultation and training regarding operational efficiencies and safety. Over twenty airlines have benefited from AEG consulting, with savings of over $40 million.

In a statement sent to the Aadland campaign, Davey said:

"It was not difficult to decide to support Erik in his run for Congress. Erik has proven his ability to lead when faced with extreme adversity, stay calm in the midst of chaos, and remain true to his character and morals even after accomplishing great success and recognition. Erik is exactly the type of pioneer we need in Congress. I have no doubt he will shine brightly in DC, just as he did when he was in the military and private sector."
|
---
|
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "I'm extremely grateful for Bruce's endorsement. Throughout his vast career, Bruce has achieved many outstanding accomplishments as a Navy fighter pilot, Blue Angel, Airline pilot and now as president of an aviation related company. It is always an honor to have a member of the military support me, especially one as talented and gifted as Bruce. I will continually strive to be the light Bruce speaks of, especially when faced with the corruption we all know is running far too rampant in DC."
---

---
|

---
| |

|
## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
|
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

| | **STATEMENT FROM CONGRESSIONAL CANDIDATE DR. JOHN DI PAOLA**
**REGARDING PRIMARY ELECTION RESULTS**
_Wilsonville, OR (June 15, 2022)_ \--- Dr. John Di Paola released the following statement regarding Oregon’s primary election results:

“The votes have been counted and unfortunately I will not be continuing to the general election in November. While I am disappointed in these results, I am proud of the work that our grassroots campaign has accomplished over the last 5 months,” stated Dr. Di Paola.

“I would like to thank all of my volunteers for your continued and unwavering encouragement. I am also incredibly grateful for my wife, Lori, for being my biggest supporter on the campaign trail.

“The voters in Oregon’s fifth congressional district are sick of being represented by a congressman who does not put America first. I look forward to continuing the fight and will work hard every day to make our country a more prosperous place to live.”

---
Dear , I wanted to reach out and personally thank each and every one of you who supported this campaign and gave your time, your money, and your vote to fight for change. Although my primary result was not what we had hoped for, we made history with this campaign, and more importantly, we opened the door to a future of possibilities. We made a difference by talking about the issues that truly matter to people - from living wages, to access to healthcare, to protecting women's reproductive rights, to prioritizing equity and inclusion both within our party and across our state. I also saw energy and excitement that many didn't think was possible for our party. It's clear that South Carolina Democrats are eager to win again, and we have to carry that energy forward. We must never stop working to create a South Carolina where everyone can thrive, and I plan to continue these efforts in my role as a State Senator. Thank you again to my friends, family, and team who supported me through it all. I'm so proud of the work we did together, and I'm filled with hope for the future of our state. With gratitude, Mia
---

Look, I know we’ve sent out a lot of emails recently about our opponent Elise Stefanik, and the threat she poses to our Democracy, but I wanted to take a minute to explain why I’m in this race. And at the end of this email I’m going to ask you to join our team and help us win in November. | [NEEDED: Chip in $3 to defeat ultra-MAGA traitor Elise Stefanik »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/46574630/350855346/-254126340?amount=3&amounts=10,25,50,100,250&refcode=MCFC_20220615_EMDF_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlM2JmNDg0MC0wZmVkLWVjMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VVdsYlZrHYuLP-RHQFL_Zr9OFPIuOL7RdCoC-TtSe1c=)
---
**1.** **I’m in this race because our country has never been more divided and our Democracy is in decline** – and my opponent, Republican Elise Stefanik, is leading its destruction.

**2.** I’m in this race because while Stefanik continually puts party before country, **I’ve dedicated my career to serving our country.**

**3.** **I’m in this race because we deserve leaders that will fight for things like rural healthcare, common sense gun safety, and a woman’s right to choose,** _not the interests of corporations and politicians that line their pockets._
---
I took an oath to support and defend the Constitution from all enemies, foreign and domestic. I won’t betray that oath and let Stefanik continue to degrade the constitution and our country.

Peter,

A few years ago, I googled _'how to start a campaign'_.

I had no idea how to even start! And let me tell you something, I still have no clue what I’m doing.

But here’s what I do know... **_we can’t go on like this as a country._**

People can’t afford to drive to work. Kids are being used as political pawns. American energy is being suppressed. Our border is open. Babies are starving due to a baby formula shortage. **And our political 'leaders' are making excuse after excuse, without a single real solution.**

[**HELP TYLER SAVE AMERICA » **](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=a6fde93384fb4ab29544af5cb87ab0e2&_e=4ad6xapHKJl-t2TVwhrEc29shoJWDJwTEIRUi57h1PGNwFaCN0P2Nra_bwxEghAUmoCW0Zd-KvY37mi0E4GezH4PHjZ3teHErTF-gjYbwmHXI6sG6yNae1CxwS7KLDOB_ecL08XW9rCS8xsbvZROJqOR2HgOi-uAI06yKWn0KX_wQa7khNsqhtRiW4EPcNqtr5cxCqSv0HLOGU6UVLd2sA_GjKY4Geq4hX55_JVMiRj1CGzwQf9AJMXS4GSft3Bf_ZtpXGWfYCQrYQtJSFLtU9glRjeoqjqcg_sSI7XUcR5Eo3OHSi02a0PVzMucLnrJ7ER1QZJMnh77IS56yjTIXZptywxTl5BUmEzkXOYPeqxMgJpABXlwCJ5oEorY_CJNWedXfX5w3ZRsnYEH1DP39u0RvhWu_CkDPcQP5j4Bj7RsGF5MR_uODg2mRO89Hee_oEvP3JOe1EIqV8x0AcV8LA%3D%3D)
When I decided in 2019 to jump into a major swing race against a well-funded Democrat, I had no resources, knowledge, or background in politics – I didn’t even have a campaign manager! **All I knew was that somebody had to step up and save our country, for our children’s sake.**

As it turns out, other Americans were on the same page as me. My message resonated with people, and we ran a historic campaign in one of the closest races in the country, losing by less than 10,000 votes.

_...and it all started with an idea and a google search._

I’m running to unseat the same Democrat once again – and just like last time this is going to be a tight race. **Democrats and Republicans alike are watching this race like a hawk, because it’s the key to the House majority.** [**Which is why the Democratic machine is dumping MILLIONS into my opponent’s bank account. But here’s what I do know... we can’t go on like this as a country. | Peter, A few years ago, I googled 'how to start a campaign'. I had no idea how to even start! And let me tell you something, I still have no clue what I’m doing. But here’s what I do know... we can’t go on like this as a country. People can’t afford to drive to work. Kids are being used as political pawns. American energy is being suppressed. Our border is open. Babies are starving due to a baby formula shortage. And our political 'leaders' are making excuse after excuse, without a single real solution. When I decided in 2019 to jump into a major swing race against a well-funded Democrat, I had no resources, knowledge, or background in politics – I didn’t even have a campaign manager! All I knew was that somebody had to step up and save our country, for our children’s sake. As it turns out, other Americans were on the same page as me. My message resonated with people, and we ran a historic campaign in one of the closest races in the country, losing by less than 10,000 votes. ...and it all started with an idea and a google search. I’m running to unseat the same Democrat once again – and just like last time this is going to be a tight race. Democrats and Republicans alike are watching this race like a hawk, because it’s the key to the House majority. if Republicans are going to retake control of the House, then it’s essential to win seats in suburban districts like the one I’m running in. With just five seats needed, we must put EVERY single seat in play. I often wonder what would have happened last time if I would have sent just one more email, knocked doors on one more Saturday, or secured one more advertisement for my campaign. Would things have turned out different? I’m not leaving anything on the table this time around, Peter. Just like the day I googled 'how to start a campaign' , I’m still learning every day. I don’t have all the answers, but I promise to learn and listen alongside you. Please, help me out today so we can save our country together. Our public lands are under attack.
| [](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4323?t=2&akid=12984%2E53494%2EZoQT69) Friend, Leasing public lands and waters for fossil fuel extraction is a terrible idea, plain and simple. Big Polluters want our leaders to respond to high gas prices by locking us into more destructive drilling, but it won't help. **There's a better way.** We just partnered with Earthjustice for a joint policy report laying out how Big Polluters are exploiting our public lands and waters to pursue destructive drilling—and forcing consumers to cover the cost by taking our tax dollars and gouging us at the pump. The policy report also outlines a roadmap the Biden administration must use to swiftly phase out new federal fossil fuel leasing and accelerate the just transition to a clean energy future. **Our policy memos have influenced the national climate agenda and set the standard for federal climate action.[_Read about our next groundbreaking policy paper now._](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4323?t=3&akid=12984%2E53494%2EZoQT69)** | [READ MORE](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4323?t=4&akid=12984%2E53494%2EZoQT69)

Here's what we're demanding the Biden administration do:
* Swiftly and legally phase out new federal fossil fuel leasing on public lands and waters
* Limit federal fossil fuel production from existing leases to align with the goals of the Paris Agreement and President Biden's climate and environmental justice commitments
* Lead a just transition away from a fossil-fueled economy while investing in an inclusive clean energy future

Seem too ambitious? It's not. We lay out exactly how to achieve these critical goals in our paper—[** _read our blog post to find out how we can get it done._**](https://act.evergreenaction.com/go/4323?t=5&akid=12984%2E53494%2EZoQT69)

Dear Friend,
My Republican primary opponent is at it again.
After months of lying about my position on funding for cities and towns, now he's trying to convince you that I'm going to use taxpayer dollars to support my race for Governor.
You know me, and you know you can trust me. And, by now, you should also know that as a consistent advocate for taxpayers and their rights, taking taxpayer money to run for Governor is the last thing I'd ever consider doing.
I've had enough of the misrepresentations. And since I know you can't rely on the media to tell you the whole story, I want you to know the truth straight from me:

* FACT: Both Leah Allen and I have pledged that we will not take one single penny of public funding for either of our campaigns in this race. Not one penny.

* FACT: I have been fighting for the rights of taxpayers in our state for more than a decade. As I campaign for Governor, I'm out there every day advocating for taxpayer relief, in particular a temporary suspension of the state gas tax.

* FACT: I support robust Local Aid for our cities and towns. Local Aid takes pressure off local property taxes and funds essential services and schools. I always have, and I always will support our cities and towns.

My campaign agreed to a voluntary spending limit for the election. Meanwhile, my opponents are lining up to spend $7.5 million in the GOP Primary, just to defeat Leah Allen and me, and our pro-taxpayer, pro-freedom message for the people of Massachusetts.
It didn't work at the MassGOP Convention, and it's not going to work at the MassGOP Primary either.
Chris Doughty needs to learn an important lesson: you can't lie or buy your way into the Governor's Office. That office belongs to the people and you have to earn the job.
That's what I'm here to do.
You can count on me.
Sincerely,
---
